Role Summary
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (MI & Reporting) to support the Data & Analytics function of one of Asia’s leading digital banks. The role is responsible for developing and automating management information dashboards and reports using data from multiple sources. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements, develop meaningful KPIs, and deliver accurate and timely insights. The ideal candidate has strong SQL and data analysis skills, hands-on experience with Amazon Athena and Amazon QuickSight, and the ability to independently manage reporting requirements from initial discussion through to delivery.

Kinh_Nghiem: • 2+ years as a data analyst or analytics engineer, working hands-on in SQL against a production data warehouse.
Mo_Ta_Cong_Viec:
Top 3 reasons to join us
• Profitable startup from Year 1!
• High pay, MacBook Pro, $1000 annual development
• Work with top talent on product changing industry
Job description
About The Opportunity
The Data Team at Flodesk is part of our Engineering Team, based in our Da Nang office. We serve as the single source of truth for the company, providing data-driven insights that empower teams across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering.
As a Data Analyst, you’ll play a crucial role in translating raw data into meaningful insights, optimizing data pipelines, and maintaining a self-service BI ecosystem that enables teams to explore and understand data effectively.
What you will do
• Data modeling and analysis: Own the dbt models and analysis behind Flodesk’s business metrics, taking raw data to tested numbers that every report agrees on. Build automated checks that reconcile data across sources, and trace any gap down to the rows behind it. Most of your work will sit in the finance domain (MRR, retention, LTV/CAC, and revenue and cost reconciliation), so prior knowledge of SaaS metrics and subscription billing models will help.
• Business partnership: Be the data partner for our business team, mostly the Finance Director and leadership. Turn their questions into well-defined metrics, help settle open definitions (say, how to count a member who converts and cancels in the same month), and build the decisions into the models.
• AI-first analytics: Do most of your building and analysis through AI agents, and own the result: checking the logic, testing edge cases, and catching what the agent got wrong. You’ll build the dashboards using AI agents and curate the metric definitions and metadata that keep MCP answers accurate.
Your skills and experience
What you need to be successful
• 2+ years as a data analyst or analytics engineer, working hands-on in SQL against a production data warehouse.
• Advanced SQL and data modeling. You pick the right grain for each table and get snapshot and point-in-time logic right. Our stack is dbt on Redshift and ClickHouse, so familiarity with dbt and Python will help.
• A fast learner with an open mind. Prior experience with subscription metrics such as MRR or LTV/CAC is welcome but not required.
• Experience doing analytics work through AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) is highly desirable, and building an analytics MCP server or semantic layer for LLM use even more so. Either way, you have the judgment to check an agent’s output rather than trust it.
• Rigor and healthy skepticism. When numbers don’t tie, you keep digging until you can explain the gap, and you’re upfront about caveats and definitional choices instead of presenting one tidy number.
• Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a metric definition to Finance without jargon, and write documentation that people (and agents) can rely on.
Why you'll love working here
We’re a profitable, fast-growing startup building email marketing software used by thousands of small businesses.
Why join us
• Impact: Your work directly helps small business owners grow.
• Culture: We’re a lean team that keeps things clear, holds a high bar for craft, stays curious, and builds with care. We work async-friendly and collaborate closely with our US and EU teams.
• Perks:
• We pay highly competitive salaries, plus a 13th-month bonus.
• Stock options for high contributors, because we want you to own a part of our success.
• Professional development: up to $1,000/year for courses, books, or conferences.
• Healthcare: annual health check, vaccinations, premium health insurance, and family health insurance covering up to 2 family members.
• Flexible working hours with a standard 5-day workweek.
• Equipment: a MacBook Pro, a Mac Studio for running AI agents (for most engineering roles), and an external screen in our modern office.
• Career growth: overseas opportunities.
If you want to build software with a small, collaborative team, we’d like to hear from you. Apply now.

Job description
ABOUT THE ROLE
• Join our Technology Innovations Center of Excellence (CoE) at Crossian, a fast-growing startup that achieved a milestone of $200M in 2025. In this dynamic role, you'll check in daily with your team to stay aligned on project goals and collaborate across our ecosystem with an Agile mindset infused with a unicorn-worthy startup culture.
• As a Data Analyst at Crossian, you’ll turn business questions into insights, decisions, and measurable outcomes. Working across the full eCommerce funnel, you’ll tackle challenges spanning customer acquisition, marketing performance, conversion, retention, finance, and post-sale operations. Your work will help shape product improvements, marketing strategies, and operational decisions, with a direct impact on how the business grows and operates.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Data Analysis & Insights
• Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across the eCommerce customer journey. Develop hypotheses and generate actionable insights to improve customer experience, identify opportunities to optimize the conversion funnel and support experimentation (A/B testing).
• Analyze key business metrics including traffic, conversion rate (CR), average order value (AOV), retention, revenue, customer lifetime value (CLV), risk and loss metrics(dispute, refund, replace), inventory levels, and production performance.
• Identify key drivers impacting product performance, marketing effectiveness, and financial metrics to support data-driven business decisions.
Dashboard & BI Development:
• Act as a BI consultant for cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Finance, Operations) to design and develop dashboards and reporting solutions that support business decision-making.
• Develop, maintain, and optimize BI dashboards and automated reports to monitor key business metrics, financial performance, and conversion funnels.
• Translate business requirements into scalable data models, metrics definitions, and visualization frameworks.
Data Management & Integration:
• Define and maintain data structures, data models, and metric definitions to ensure consistency across analytics and reporting.
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across BI dashboards and reporting systems.
• Collaborate with data engineering and product teams to design scalable data pipelines and event tracking frameworks.
Team Collaboration:
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Content, Product, Finance, and Operations to understand data requirements and support data-driven decision-making.
Your skills and experience
• Educational Background: Bachelor's degree preferred in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
• Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar analytical role.
Technical Skills:
• Good understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts. Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
• Hands-on experience with BI tools such as QuickSight ,Power BI, or Looker.
• Experience using Python for data analysis and automation (e.g., Pandas, Matplotlib)
Data Analysis
• Experience performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights
• Experience with A/B testing and experimentation analysis, analyzing eCommerce metrics such as conversion rate, AOV, retention, and customer lifetime value
Language
• Professional working proficiency in English

• Career Growth: Defined promotion paths, mentorship from senior analytics leaders, and a robust L&D budget.
• High-Impact Culture: Deliver insights and dashboards that inform C-suite strategy and multimillion-dollar decisions.
• Your Voice Matters at Crossian: You own your work and have every opportunity to showcase your capabilities.

Job description
Chúng tôi xây dựng hạ tầng đo lường và chứng nhận kết quả phát triển con người, với mục tiêu để những cải thiện thật sự trong đời sống con người trở thành thứ có thể kiểm chứng và tài trợ được. Nhóm Dữ liệu và Đo lường là nơi bằng chứng được tạo ra: thiết kế thước đo, xử lý dữ liệu, kiểm định, và chịu trách nhiệm về độ tin cậy của mọi con số đi ra khỏi hệ thống.
Trước mắt, công việc tập trung vào pilot đo lường của một ứng dụng chăm sóc sức khỏe tinh thần, với ba kênh dữ liệu chạy song song:
• Nhật ký trong ứng dụng: sự kiện và nhãn trạng thái từ các tính năng, không có nội dung hội thoại.
• Lời mời ngẫu nhiên: check-in vào thời điểm rút ngẫu nhiên, dùng để sửa độ lệch do người dùng tự chọn lúc mở ứng dụng.
• Bảng hỏi tuần: ba bộ công cụ làm ngoài ứng dụng, trong đó có một thang quốc tế chưa có bản tiếng Việt đã thẩm định.
Nội dung công việc:
1. Xây và vận hành pipeline đo lường
• Biến đặc tả công thức thành code chạy được và chạy lặp lại được: chấm điểm bảng hỏi, tính chỉ số từ nhật ký, ghép ba kênh dữ liệu theo cửa sổ thời gian.
• Viết kiểm tra chất lượng dữ liệu ở mọi bước: tỉ lệ đủ trường bắt buộc, giá trị ngoài miền cho phép, lệch múi giờ, sự kiện gửi lên trễ, trùng bản ghi.
• Dựng bộ báo cáo định kỳ cho nhóm nghiên cứu và cho tổ chức, trong đó số liệu cho tổ chức luôn là số gộp.
• Làm việc với đội kỹ thuật ứng dụng về hợp đồng sự kiện: thiếu trường nào, nhãn nào không nhất quán giữa các phiên bản, log nào không đủ để tính chỉ số đã hứa.
2. Phân tích và kiểm định thống kê
• Chạy các phân tích đã đăng ký trước: mô hình đa tầng cho dữ liệu lặp theo tuần, mô hình cho biến thứ bậc và biến danh mục, phân tích thời gian tới sự kiện có dữ liệu bị cắt, phân tích nhân quả cho thử nghiệm ngẫu nhiên lặp lại trong ứng dụng.
• Thẩm định công cụ đo: độ tin cậy, cấu trúc nhân tố, độ ổn định qua các tuần, độ khớp giữa nhãn máy gán và nhãn người xác nhận.
• Xử lý các vấn đề không tránh được của loại dữ liệu này: dữ liệu thiếu không ngẫu nhiên, người dùng tự chọn thời điểm đo, cỡ mẫu nhỏ cho từng người, so sánh nhiều lần.
• Chạy mô phỏng để tính cỡ mẫu và để kiểm tra chính phương pháp phân tích trước khi có dữ liệu thật.
• Viết phần phương pháp và phần kết quả, kèm phần giới hạn trung thực, cho tài liệu nội bộ và cho đối tác kiểm chứng độc lập.
3. Quản trị dữ liệu và tính liêm chính của bằng chứng
• Thực thi các quy tắc riêng tư trong code, không chỉ trong tài liệu: ngưỡng gộp tối thiểu, chống suy ngược ra nhóm bị ẩn, tách dữ liệu định danh khỏi dữ liệu phân tích.
• Giữ dấu vết của mọi con số: từ bản ghi gốc tới chỉ số cuối cùng, phiên bản code và phiên bản dữ liệu nào tạo ra nó.
• Tham gia viết bản đăng ký trước, và ghi lại mọi thay đổi sau khi đã đăng ký vào một sổ chỉ ghi thêm.
• Phát hiện và báo cáo các trường hợp cần can thiệp an toàn theo quy trình, trong thời hạn đã cam kết.

• Nền tảng suy luận thống kê vững: hiểu điều một kiểm định thực sự nói và không nói; phân biệt ý nghĩa thống kê với độ lớn hiệu ứng; biết vì sao khoảng tin cậy thường hữu ích hơn một giá trị p.
• Dữ liệu lặp theo thời gian: mô hình đa tầng hoặc mô hình hiệu ứng hỗn hợp; tách biến động trong một người khỏi khác biệt giữa người với người.
• Biến không liên tục: hồi quy logistic, mô hình cho biến thứ bậc, mô hình cho dữ liệu đếm.
• Dữ liệu thiếu: phân biệt các cơ chế thiếu dữ liệu và biết hệ quả của từng cơ chế lên kết luận.
• Đo lường: độ tin cậy, độ giá trị, sai số đo, và vì sao một thang dịch sang ngôn ngữ khác phải được kiểm lại trước khi dùng.

• Python hoặc R ở mức thành thạo, đủ để viết pipeline chứ không chỉ chạy phân tích rời rạc trong notebook. Ứng viên mạnh thường dùng được cả hai.
• SQL ở mức viết được truy vấn nhiều bảng, hàm cửa sổ, và xử lý dữ liệu có mốc thời gian.
• Git và thói quen làm việc có review code.
• Dữ liệu dạng sự kiện: ghép chuỗi sự kiện theo cửa sổ thời gian, xử lý sự kiện đến trễ hoặc trùng, làm việc với múi giờ.
• Khả năng tái lập: cùng một dữ liệu và cùng một phiên bản code phải cho cùng một con số, không phụ thuộc vào việc ai chạy.
3. Cách làm việc
• Viết được bằng tiếng Việt rõ ràng cho người không làm thống kê, và đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh.
• Nói thẳng về giới hạn của phân tích, kể cả khi kết quả không như mong đợi của dự án.
• Cẩn thận với dữ liệu về đời sống nội tâm của người khác. Đây là yêu cầu bắt buộc, không phải điểm cộng.
4. Điểm cộng
• Thống kê Bayes: Stan, PyMC, brms, mô hình phân cấp (Hierarchical Models).
• Tâm trắc học (Psychometrics) : Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA), Item Response Theory (IRT), Measurement Invariance.
• Thử nghiệm trong sản phẩm: Micro-randomized Trials, Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD), Interrupted Time Series (ITS).
• Dữ liệu chuỗi sự kiện: Point Processes, Survival Analysis, Irregularly Spaced Data.
• Đánh giá nhãn do mô hình ngôn ngữ gán: Inter-rater Agreement, Annotator Error Models, Measurement Error Correction.
• Hạ tầng dữ liệu: Dagster, Apache Airflow, dbt, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Docker.
• Riêng tư trong phân tích: Data Anonymization, Re-identification Risk Assessment, ARX.
• Nền tảng lĩnh vực: Psychology, Public Health, Econometrics, Computational Social Science.

• Được tham gia dự án ERP/AI ERP thực tế trong đa lĩnh vực.
• Được làm việc trực tiếp với bài toán vận hành thật của doanh nghiệp lớn.
• Được đào tạo và hướng dẫn bởi Senior BA/PM/Solution Consultant.

Job description
Acting as the hands-on senior authority on data analytics and data modeling. The immediate priority is elevating the quality, structure, and business value of Power BI reporting/dashboards — the data warehouse itself is stable and maintained by the Data Engineer. Production database administration sits with IT Infrastructure's DBA, outside this role's scope. This position translates business questions into well-modeled, reliable dashboards, mentors the team, and acts as the main point of contact between the data function and business stakeholders.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Data Modeling & BI
• Design and review data models that support reporting (star schema, relationships, DAX measures) to replace ad hoc/inconsistent report logic.
• Personally build or closely review complex/critical dashboards, especially where current models are weak.
• Define standard KPI logic so metrics are consistent across dashboards (a lightweight "single source of truth" for definitions, not a new platform).
• Enable self-service reporting for business users where practical.
Data Engineering Oversight
• Oversee the Data Engineer's pipeline/warehouse work; do not need to build pipelines personally, but must be able to diagnose data issues and guide fixes.
• Ensure data quality issues surfaced in dashboards are traced back and resolved at the source (looping in the DBA's team only when the issue is confirmed to be on the production-database side).
Business Partnership
• Work directly with Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Operations to scope reporting needs.
• Present insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders in English and Vietnamese.
Innovation (nice-to-have)
• Identify opportunities to apply automation or AI/ML to reporting workflows and analysis (e.g. anomaly detection, forecasting, report automation) as capacity allows — not a core deliverable of the role.
Team Leadership
• Manage and mentor the Data Engineer and 2 BI Analysts; set priorities and review work quality.
• Own workload prioritization across ad hoc requests and standing reports.
Your skills and experience
• 5+ years in Data Analytics/BI, including hands-on Power BI report and data model building; 2+ years leading or mentoring others.
• Strong Power BI + DAX (must be able to build and troubleshoot complex measures/models personally, not just direct others).

Job description
About the role
GSM is building intelligent decision systems that power large-scale mobility and logistics operations. We're looking for a Senior/Expert Data Scientist to lead the development of machine learning and optimization models, plus decision-intelligence solutions across dynamic pricing, driver incentives, smart navigation, and marketplace efficiency.
This role is primarily focused on pricing and driver incentive/navigation , while also contributing to other high-impact decision problems across the organization. You'll work end-to-end — from problem framing and feature design to model development, experimentation, and measuring production impact.
We're looking for someone with strong applied-ML and analytics foundations who enjoys solving complex real-world problems using data, experimentation, and scalable machine learning.
What you'll do
Build and improve core ML models for operational decision systems
• Develop and iterate on ML solutions for dynamic pricing, dynamic driver incentive, driver smart navigation, and near-real-time demand/supply forecasting
• Design features from user behavior, driver behavior, geospatial data, and marketplace/operational signals
Drive experimentation and model improvement
• Design and execute offline and online experiments
• Define evaluation methodologies and success metrics
• Conduct root-cause analysis and model diagnostics
• Identify opportunities to improve model quality, stability, and business impact
Research and apply advanced ML techniques
• Apply modern approaches including gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost), ranking & optimization methods, scoring & recommendation techniques, and spatio-temporal modeling
• Explore new approaches through rapid prototyping and data-driven validation
Partner across functions
• Collaborate with Product, Operations, Engineering, and Analytics to turn business challenges into measurable ML solutions
• Work closely with ML Engineers to productionize models and monitor performance
• Communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations to stakeholders
Own the end-to-end Data Science lifecycle
• Problem framing → data exploration → feature engineering → model development → offline evaluation → experimentation (A/B and switchback testing) → production monitoring and iteration

Required
• Strong background in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field
• 4+ years building and deploying machine learning solutions in production
• Strong Python and SQL skills
• Solid understanding of supervised learning, feature engineering, model validation, and experimentation (A/B / switchback testing)
• Hands-on experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost or similar; large-scale structured/tabular datasets; and model evaluation & performance analysis
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to translate business objectives into measurable ML outcomes
Strong plus
• Experience with recommendation systems, optimization systems, or ranking & scoring systems

• Experience designing online experiments and measuring causal impact
• Strong Kaggle profile or competitive ML experience

Job description
About the Role
We are looking for a data scientist who combines strong statistical and machine learning foundations with curiosity, independent judgment, and practical business sense.
You will work with messy, real-world data to solve problems in forecasting, optimization, customer intelligence, and operations across our e-commerce and agriculture technology businesses. Working with business and engineering teams, you will take problems from the initial question through investigation, experimentation, and delivery.
You thrive in a small, hands-on team where priorities evolve and problems are not always fully defined.
You take initiative, use AI tools and agents effectively, and own work through to a useful result.
What You Will Do
Modeling Forecasting and Optimization
• Independently develop modeling and optimization approaches suited to the business problem, available data, objectives, and practical constraints.
• Compare alternative methods against meaningful baselines, using evaluations that reflect how the results will be used.
• Investigate model failures and unexpected results, then propose and test improvements.
• Work with engineering teammates to bring useful models into production and translate results into decisions.
Data Science and Analytics
• Explore complex datasets, identify patterns and anomalies, and formulate hypotheses worth testing.
• Validate sources, metric definitions, and assumptions; investigate inconsistencies that could affect the answer.
• Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests, using appropriate statistical methods.
• Test competing explanations, distinguish correlation from causation, and produce reproducible analyses with clear limitations.
AI and Applied Generative AI
• Use AI tools and agents to increase productivity, automate routine work, and accelerate research, analysis, coding, evaluation, and reporting through reusable workflows.
• Use AI to explore approaches and challenge assumptions, retaining responsibility for the reasoning and correctness of the result.
• Evaluate new tools, models, agents, and reusable skills on representative tasks, balancing quality, reliability, speed, and cost.
• Build and evaluate AI-powered tools for information retrieval, classification, extraction, and decision support.
Product and Business Collaboration
• Turn broad business requests into analytical questions, objectives, and success measures,
• questioning assumptions and identifying missing context.
• Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences, connecting the evidence, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and recommended action.
• Prioritize by expected business value, balancing rigor with speed and available resources.
• Incorporate stakeholder knowledge and material feedback, resolving open questions or agreeing how they will be handled.
Data Architecture Engineering and Model Operations
Your work will sometimes extend into data engineering, with an emphasis on architecture, reusable systems, and automated operations.
• Design reusable datasets, features, feature-store structures, and pipelines with clear definitions and traceable sources.
• Take selected components from design through implementation, working with engineering teammates where appropriate.
• Build in quality checks, automated evaluation, and monitoring to detect data failures, model drift, and performance degradation and inform retraining or revision.
• Make practical architecture decisions that balance reliability, flexibility, cost, and maintenance; document systems so teammates can support them.
Example Projects
Depending on business priorities, you may work on:
• Forecasting and planning: improve demand forecasts and help buyers understand changes, uncertainty, and inventory implications.
• Optimization: recommend replenishment quantities, inventory allocations, or resource plans within business constraints.
• Customer intelligence: develop segmentation, recommendation, or retention models for e-commerce and SaaS businesses.
• Agriculture technology: build yield, harvest, or operational planning tools.
• AI-powered decision support: combine business data, information retrieval, and agent workflows to help users investigate questions and act.
Your skills and experience
Required Qualifications
• Demonstrated ability to independently lead substantive data science work, from an ambiguous business question through investigation, evaluation, and delivery. We assess seniority through analytical judgment, ownership, and results rather than a fixed number of years.
• Strong foundations in statistics, probability, experimental design, and machine learning, with practical experience in forecasting or optimization.
• Strong Python and SQL skills, including experience with common data analysis and machine learning libraries.
• Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data platforms.
• Demonstrated use of AI tools and agents in substantive analytical or development work, including validating their outputs and explaining the reasoning.
• Natural curiosity and self-directed learning. You actively explore new methods, tools, and AI capabilities, test their practical value, and apply what proves useful. You investigate unfamiliar problems and unexpected results without waiting to be directed.
• Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.
• A degree in a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Job description
Daiichi Life Vietnam is building a value-focused Data Analytics & AI function to develop and operationalize predictive models across customer growth , renewal premium collection, persistency and claims. We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist who can independently lead complex modeling work, guide junior specialists and partner with business teams to convert models into controlled interventions and measurable financial outcomes.
PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
1. ADVANCED MODEL DEVELOPMENT & TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP
• Lead end-to-end analytical work for assigned use cases, including problem framing, data assessment, label design, feature engineering, model development and model selection.
• Develop robust statistical and machine-learning models, including GLM, gradient boosting, survival, severity, anomaly-detection and treatment-response / uplift approaches as applicable.
• Design evaluation frameworks covering discrimination, calibration, stability, explainability, fairness and segment-level performance.
• Review code and methodology, mentor junior data scientists and promote reproducible development, testing and documentation standards.
• Translate complex model behavior into clear business drivers, limitations, reason codes and decision recommendations.
2. EXPERIMENTATION, IMPLEMENTATION & MODEL LIFECYCLE
• Partner with Analytics Product Managers to define interventions, controlled pilots, success thresholds and incremental-value measurement.
• Prepare production scoring specifications and work with Data Engineering, BI, IT and business teams to integrate model outputs into operational workflows.
• Prepare development documentation, respond to independent validation and ensure approval conditions are addressed before deployment.
• Establish and monitor model-performance, data-drift and business-value indicators; recommend recalibration, retraining, restriction or retirement.
• Engage Actuarial, Claims, Distribution, Customer Service and Risk teams to ensure models are technically sound, commercially relevant and responsibly used.
Your skills and experience
• Bachelor or Master degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or a related quantitative field.
• Minimum 5-8 years of experience in data science, machine learning, actuarial analytics or quantitative modeling, with demonstrated end-to-end project ownership.
• Strong expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning, including GLM, tree-based models, model calibration and explainability.
• Practical experience with AI or LLM-enabled solutions, such as prompt workflows, semantic search, RAG, text analytics or conversational interfaces.
• Understanding of LLM evaluation, including how to assess relevance, factuality, consistency, safety and business usefulness.
• Practical experience in at least one advanced area such as survival analysis, causal inference, uplift modeling, anomaly detection, frequency / severity modeling or recommender systems.
• Advanced SQL and strong R or Python programming skills, including reproducible workflows, version control and code review.
• Experience operationalizing models, designing controlled experiments and monitoring models after deployment.
• Life insurance, banking, customer analytics, claims or fraud analytics experience is strongly preferred.
• Strong stakeholder communication and mentoring skills, with fluency in English.

• Full of social welfare under Vietnamese Labor Law (Insurance, annual leave, ...)
• Healthcare for yourself & Your Family
• Annual travel and team building activities
• 15-16 annual leave days
• Company will buy Life Insurance Contract for yourself after 1 year working
• Training: Trained in soft and technical skills
• International, challenging, and friendly working environment

• Opportunity to access and work directly with financial data, and to build market analysis models.
• A young, dynamic working environment with chances to develop skills and learn from industry experts.
• Initial financial support starts at 3 million VND, with potential increases throughout the internship depending on performance and demonstrated capability.
• Lunch allowance is provided, and working hours are flexible to fit your schedule.
• Opportunities to join annual trips and team-building activities.
Working Hours : 08:30 AM - 17:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with 1,5 hours lunch break (Interns can have flexible working hours to accommodate their class schedules).

Kinh_Nghiem: • 1. Từ 4 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí BA, Product Owner, Functional Consultant hoặc tương đương trong lĩnh vực phần mềm, ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm trong mảng bán lẻ (retail), thương mại điện tử (ecommerce), logistics.\n• 2. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc liên phòng ban (cross-team), điều phối và kết nối các bộ phận để thống nhất yêu cầu, phạm vi và tiến độ.
Mo_Ta_Cong_Viec:
Top 3 reasons to join us
• Đãi ngộ hấp dẫn, thu nhập phù hợp năng lực
• Môi trường TRẺ chuyên nghiệp, sáng tạo,cạnh tranh
• Được đào tạo nâng cao năng lực
Job description
Phân tích nghiệp vụ & Thiết kế sản phẩm
• 1. Khảo sát nghiệp vụ end-to-end: làm việc với các bộ phận (cửa hàng, kho/DC, mua hàng, giao nhận, Ecom, kế toán…) và đi thực tế tại cửa hàng/kho; phân tích ngược từ yêu cầu để tìm ra điểm vướng và nhu cầu thật, thay vì chỉ xử lý từng yêu cầu nhỏ, tức thời.
• 2. Đề xuất giải pháp và đánh giá ảnh hưởng: tối ưu cả sản phẩm lẫn quy trình nghiệp vụ, ưu tiên tự động hóa thao tác thủ công; đánh giá ảnh hưởng lên toàn quy trình và các bộ phận liên quan, báo người chịu trách nhiệm quy trình (process owner) để điều chỉnh vận hành phù hợp; cùng người dùng chuẩn hóa quy trình để dễ kiểm soát.
• 3. Thiết kế giải pháp: dựng luồng sử dụng, khung giao diện (wireframe), bản mẫu (mockup/prototype) để người dùng dễ hình dung, ưu tiên đơn giản, thao tác nhanh; tích hợp sẵn cơ chế hạn chế sai sót do con người (kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập, cảnh báo, phân quyền, phê duyệt, lưu vết thao tác) và cấu hình/tham số linh hoạt để dễ mở rộng khi mô hình kinh doanh thay đổi mà hạn chế phải lập trình lại.
• 4. Chạy thử và chốt phương án: trình bày thiết kế, cho người dùng chạy thử quy trình trên bản mẫu để góp ý, điều chỉnh; thống nhất phạm vi với người dùng và đội nhóm trước khi phát triển.
• 5. Xác định KPI và thứ tự ưu tiên: đặt mục tiêu, chỉ số đo lường cho từng tính năng; đề xuất thứ tự ưu tiên dựa trên giá trị mang lại cho mục tiêu kinh doanh và chốt với quản lý trực tiếp.
• 6. Viết tài liệu yêu cầu đầy đủ: user story, điều kiện nghiệm thu, tình huống nghiệp vụ, trường hợp ngoại lệ, quy tắc kiểm tra dữ liệu đầu vào (validation); phối hợp đội lập trình thiết kế luồng tích hợp, đồng bộ dữ liệu với ERP, Ecom, logistics (luồng dữ liệu, ánh xạ trường thông tin).
• 7. Bàn giao cho Dev/QC: trình bày user story với đội lập trình (Dev) và kiểm thử (QC) để làm rõ yêu cầu, thống nhất cách hiểu trước khi thực hiện.
Triển khai và cải tiến
• 8. Đồng hành cùng đội phát triển: giải đáp nghiệp vụ cho đội lập trình (Dev) và kiểm thử (QC) trong quá trình phát triển; tham gia nghiệm thu (UAT) cùng người dùng trước khi đưa vào vận hành.
• 9. Đưa tính năng vào sử dụng: chuẩn bị tài liệu hướng dẫn, đào tạo người dùng và hỗ trợ xử lý vướng mắc trong giai đoạn đầu vận hành.
• 10. Đo lường và cải tiến: sau khi ra mắt, theo dõi mức độ sử dụng và hiệu quả tính năng so với KPI đã đặt; thu thập phản hồi người dùng để đề xuất cải tiến tiếp theo.
• 11. Ứng dụng AI vào công việc: chủ động dùng công cụ AI (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini…) để rút ngắn thời gian phân tích, viết tài liệu, dựng bản mẫu và rà soát yêu cầu.
Your skills and experience
Kinh nghiệm & kiến thức
• 1. Từ 4 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí BA, Product Owner, Functional Consultant hoặc tương đương trong lĩnh vực phần mềm, ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm trong mảng bán lẻ (retail), thương mại điện tử (ecommerce), logistics.
• 2. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc liên phòng ban (cross-team), điều phối và kết nối các bộ phận để thống nhất yêu cầu, phạm vi và tiến độ.
• 3. Đã làm việc theo mô hình Agile/Scrum; sử dụng thành thạo Jira, Confluence hoặc công cụ tương đương.
• 4. Ưu tiên (không bắt buộc): có hiểu biết về hệ thống ERP và cách vận hành của công ty bán lẻ thực phẩm.
• 5. Hiểu cơ bản về cơ sở dữ liệu và API, đọc được tài liệu API và ánh xạ dữ liệu (data mapping) giữa các hệ thống để trao đổi được với đội lập trình.
Kỹ năng chuyên môn
• 6. Tư duy logic tốt: phân tích được nghiệp vụ theo toàn bộ luồng end-to-end (full flow) qua các bộ phận liên quan và nhu cầu người dùng; biết vẽ sơ đồ luồng quy trình.
• 7. Mô tả được quy trình hiện tại (AS-IS), đề xuất quy trình cải tiến (TO-BE) và nhận diện được các bước có thể chuẩn hóa, tự động hóa.
• 8. Có tư duy UX tốt, thiết kế giao diện đơn giản, dễ thao tác; dựng được khung giao diện và bản mẫu rõ ràng bằng Figma hoặc công cụ tương đương (không yêu cầu kỹ năng đồ họa chuyên sâu).
• 9. Biết thiết kế cơ chế kiểm soát trong hệ thống (kiểm tra dữ liệu nhập, phân quyền, luồng phê duyệt, lưu vết) và thiết kế tính năng theo cấu hình/tham số để dễ mở rộng.
• 10. Viết được user story, điều kiện nghiệm thu (acceptance criteria) rõ ràng và lường trước các trường hợp ngoại lệ; viết tài liệu mạch lạc, giao tiếp và trình bày tốt, làm việc được với cả người dùng nghiệp vụ lẫn đội lập trình.
• 11. Tiếng Anh tốt cả 4 kỹ năng nghe, nói, đọc, viết để làm việc với đối tác nước ngoài.
• 12. Biết ứng dụng công cụ AI vào công việc hằng ngày và chia sẻ được ví dụ cụ thể.
• 13. Biết đặt KPI cho tính năng và tự truy vấn số liệu để theo dõi hiệu quả, rút ra nhận định; vận dụng được phương pháp xếp thứ tự ưu tiên
Tư duy & thái độ
• 14. Luôn khao khát tạo ra những tính năng đơn giản, dễ sử dụng, giúp người dùng cải thiện hiệu suất làm việc; có tư duy tự động hóa các hoạt động vận hành lặp đi lặp lại và giảm thiểu sai sót do con người (human error).
• 15. Bình tĩnh giải quyết vấn đề phát sinh; luôn chủ động tìm hiểu các ảnh hưởng liên quan đến tính năng mình đang làm.
• 16. Chủ động học hỏi, cập nhật công nghệ mới; chịu được áp lực công việc để hoàn thành trách nhiệm được giao, luôn tìm cách cải tiến công việc để tăng năng suất và hiệu quả.
• 17. Sẵn sàng đi thực tế tại cửa hàng, kho; kiên nhẫn hướng dẫn và truyền đạt dễ hiểu cho người dùng không chuyên về công nghệ.
Ưu tiên ứng viên
Ứng viên chỉ cần đáp ứng một trong các tiêu chí sau (không bắt buộc đáp ứng tất cả):
• Đã tham gia dự án vận hành siêu thị: bán hàng, khuyến mãi, kiểm kê, quản lý cửa hàng…
• Đã tham gia dự án vận hành hàng hóa: từ nhà cung cấp về trung tâm phân phối (DC), từ DC về siêu thị.
• Đã làm việc với phân hệ kế toán trong ERP: công nợ, đối soát, hóa đơn…
• Có tài liệu phân tích hoặc sản phẩm thiết kế có thể chia sẻ (portfolio).
Lưu ý: Ứng viên sử dụng laptop cá nhân khi làm việc.
Why you'll love working here
• Đóng bảo hiểm xã hội trên 100% mức lương.
• Làm việc 6 tiếng/ngày (9h–16h), tập trung năng suất để có thời gian hợp lý cho bản thân và gia đình.
• Chế độ nghỉ phép hấp dẫn: ngoài số ngày phép theo quy định của pháp luật, còn có phép thâm niên và phép nghỉ sinh nhật cho bản thân và người thân (vợ/chồng, con cái).
• Review tăng lương hàng năm

Job description
Founded in 2016, Katalon is the category leader in AI-augmented software testing, empowering hybrid testers—those blending manual, automation, and AI skills—to deliver exceptional digital experiences. Katalon enables software teams of any size to deliver world-class customer experiences faster, easier, and more efficiently.
Since its first launch, Katalon has experienced tremendous growth, serving more than 30,000 teams across 80+ countries, many of which are in the Fortune Global 500. Katalon has been named a G2 Leader in software testing for 11 consecutive quarters and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.
About the role
The Head of Data leads Katalon's data strategy, platform, and governance to empower business decisions, product innovation, and AI initiatives. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to build scalable data capabilities, drive operational excellence, and enable the organization to leverage data and AI as competitive advantages.
Your Responsibilities
• Define and execute Katalon's enterprise data strategy to support business growth, product innovation, and AI initiatives.
• Build and scale modern data platforms and architecture that enable analytics, machine learning, and AI-powered products.
• Establish enterprise-wide data governance, quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards (including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA).
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver actionable insights and AI-ready data capabilities.
• Drive the adoption of advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and AI-powered decision-making where they create measurable business value.
• Develop scalable data pipelines, KPIs, executive dashboards, and self-service analytics to foster a data-driven culture.
• Evaluate and implement modern data and AI technologies to continuously improve platform capabilities.
• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing Data team while driving technical excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
Your skills and experience
What you bring
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
• 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, or Business Intelligence, including leadership experience in high-growth technology or SaaS companies.
• Proven track record of defining and executing enterprise data strategies that deliver measurable business impact.
Technical Expertise
• Strong experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar.
• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), data orchestration (Airflow), streaming technologies (Kafka), and scalable data architectures.
• Strong programming skills in SQL and Python.
AI & Leadership
• Solid understanding of machine learning, MLOps, and building AI-ready data platforms.
• Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, vector databases, or RAG architectures is a strong plus.
• Ability to translate business strategy into data and AI roadmaps, influence executive stakeholders, and lead cross-functional initiatives.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills, with a passion for building a data-driven and AI-enabled organization.

• Experience building AI-native or AI-enabled SaaS products.
• Experience with experimentation platforms, recommendation systems, or personalization engines.
• Familiarity with AI governance, Responsible AI, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.
• Experience leading Data + AI transformation initiatives across multiple business functions.

The Centralized Data Platform (CDP) unifies it into one trusted layer. Every team and client consumes it as a service through APIs and MCP, never through ad-hoc exports.

• Điều phối và lập lịch luồng dữ liệu bằng công cụ orchestration (Airflow hoặc tương đương); xây dựng cơ chế retry, backfill, idempotency.

Job description
2026TD450582 - [All level] AI Engineer (Computer Vision/NLP/LLM)
MB là một trong những ngân hàng hệ sinh thái Số dẫn đầu tại Việt Nam, với định hướng trở thành “Doanh nghiệp số, Tập đoàn tài chính dẫn đầu”, công nghệ tại MB hiện được thúc đẩy dựa trên 5 trụ cột cốt lõi: công nghệ mới, tự động hóa, dữ liệu, AI và con người. Tính đến năm 2026, ngân hàng đang được phục vụ gần 40 triệu khách hàng, xử lý hơn 12,4 tỷ giao dịch trên kênh Số. Hiện tại, chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm cơ hội hợp tác cùng các ứng viên AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer có năng lực chuyên môn sâu để gia nhập và phát triển các sản phẩm Số phục vụ quy mô người dùng lớn. Đây sẽ là cơ hội để Bạn thực hiện khát vọng phát triển những nền tảng ứng dụng AI tiên tiến cùng tiềm năng tạo ảnh hướng lớn đến cộng đồng cùng MB.
Mô tả công việc:
Nhân sự AI tại MB sẽ tham gia các dự án khác nhau tùy theo thế mạnh chuyên môn và nhu cầu phát triển năng lực của bản thân, có thể kể đến các mảng công việc sau:
1. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML toàn diện (end-to-end), như LLM, pipeline RAG, semantic search), AI Agent, chatbot, fraud detection.
2. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML trong lĩnh vực Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision), bao gồm eKYC, OCR, segmentation, classification, camera AI.
3. Coding, test metrics, service và unit test theo mô hình DevOps, MLOps
4. Tích hợp và tối ưu hóa quy trình làm việc AI bằng các framework và công cụ như LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face,...
5. Nghiên cứu và áp dụng các nghiên cứu mới ( SOTA) như Reinforcement Learning, Self-Supervised Learning và Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning...
Với nhóm ứng viên là sinh viên tài năng và fresher: yêu cầu tham gia các chương trình đào tạo và dự án mới tại MB để để phát triển lên các vị trí Kỹ sư cấp cao tại MB trong tương lai gần

Job description
• Thiết kế và xây dựng AI agents và ứng dụng LLM: gọi công cụ (tool/function calling), quy trình nhiều bước, đầu ra có cấu trúc (structured output), guardrails; đảm bảo độ tin cậy với retry, xử lý giới hạn tốc độ (rate limit) và kiểm tra an toàn.

Job description
We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer with a strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, OCR & Document Understanding, and AI Agent/Multi-Agent systems, with the ability to develop, optimize, and deploy AI models in production. This role focuses on Core AI/ML Engineering, LLM Fine-tuning, and Agentic AI. Candidates are expected to have hands-on model training and fine-tuning experience, rather than solely LLM API integration, prompt engineering, or RAG chatbot development.
• Research, develop, train, fine-tune, and deploy AI/ML models.
• Fine-tune open-source LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and SFT.
• Develop OCR, Document Understanding, and Information Extraction solutions.
• Design and implement AI Agent and Multi-Agent systems for complex workflows.
• Build and optimize model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines.
• Research and implement advanced AI techniques from academic papers.
Your skills and experience
• Education: Bachelor's degree/Master’s degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Experience : Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML (industry experience)
• Programming : Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL.
• ML Frameworks & Libraries : PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas.
• AI/Deep Learning : Strong understanding of ML, DL, NLP, and Transformer architectures.
• LLM Fine-tuning : Hands-on experience with LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and SFT on models such as Qwen, Llama, and Mistral.
• AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems : LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent; tool calling, agent orchestration, multi-agent collaboration.
• Document AI : OCR, Document Layout Analysis, and Information Extraction.
• Model Optimization : GPU/CUDA, quantization, hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation.
• Deployment : FastAPI, RESTful APIs, vLLM, or equivalent frameworks.
• Database : PostgreSQL, MySQL.
• DevOps : Docker, Git (version control), Linux, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
• Language: English
Nice to have
• Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, MLOps, and distributed training.

• Chịu trách nhiệm thiết kế giải pháp, phát triển, triển khai và tối ưu hệ thống backend cho các sản phẩm voice tại VPBank, bao gồm Callbot, AI Tutor/Coaching, Virtual QC, Voice Analytics, Information Extraction và các ứng dụng xử lý giọng nói, hội thoại.
• Chuyển hóa yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thành giải pháp kỹ thuật; trực tiếp xây dựng API, dịch vụ backend, luồng xử lý và cơ chế tích hợp các thành phần AI để đưa sản phẩm vào vận hành thực tế.
• Thiết kế và phát triển các hệ thống xử lý thời gian thực (realtime) và theo lô (batch), đáp ứng yêu cầu về độ trễ, khả năng xử lý đồng thời, tính ổn định, khả năng mở rộng và bảo mật của Ngân hàng.
• Tham gia xây dựng các thành phần backend dùng chung cho Voice Platform, chuẩn hóa khả năng tích hợp và tái sử dụng để rút ngắn thời gian triển khai các use case mới.
• Đóng vai trò đầu mối kỹ thuật trong phạm vi được giao; chủ động đề xuất giải pháp, review thiết kế, review code và hướng dẫn các thành viên khác trong nhóm.
Your skills and experience
Kiến thức/ Chuyên môn có liên quan
• Nắm vững kiến thức về thiết kế phần mềm, cấu trúc dữ liệu, lập trình hướng đối tượng, lập trình bất đồng bộ, xử lý đồng thời và nguyên tắc xây dựng hệ thống phân tán.
• Thành thạo ít nhất một ngôn ngữ phát triển backend như Python, Java, Go hoặc TypeScript/Node.js; có khả năng thiết kế, phát triển và tối ưu dịch vụ backend trên production.
• Có kiến thức vững về thiết kế API, giao tiếp giữa các dịch vụ và các giao thức phục vụ realtime/streaming như WebSocket, gRPC streaming hoặc công nghệ tương đương.
• Hiểu và vận dụng được các cơ chế quản lý kết nối, quản lý trạng thái phiên, timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency và backpressure trong hệ thống bất đồng bộ.
• Có khả năng thiết kế dữ liệu và làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ như PostgreSQL/MySQL; hiểu cách sử dụng cache, message broker/job queue và object storage.
• Hiểu cách tích hợp và điều phối các dịch vụ AI có thời gian phản hồi biến động; biết thiết kế cơ chế kiểm soát lỗi, giới hạn tải và fallback.
• Có kiến thức về Docker, Git, CI/CD, kiểm thử tự động và observability; hiểu các nguyên tắc triển khai, giám sát và tối ưu hệ thống production.
• Có khả năng phân tích yêu cầu nghiệp vụ, thiết kế giải pháp tổng thể và chuyển thành các thành phần kỹ thuật có thể triển khai, kiểm thử và vận hành.
Các kinh nghiệm liên quan:
• Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm , chuyên sâu backend và triển khai hệ thống production.
• Đã trực tiếp thiết kế, phát triển hệ thống AI realtime (AI Assistant, chatbot, streaming, audio/video...) và xử lý các bài toán về độ trễ, khả năng mở rộng, tính ổn định.
• Có kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt kỹ thuật end-to-end cho một dịch vụ/phân hệ từ phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế, phát triển, kiểm thử đến triển khai và vận hành.
Ưu tiên
• Kinh nghiệm xây dựng platform/dịch vụ dùng chung , workflow engine hoặc nền tảng low-code/no-code.
• Từng phát triển các sản phẩm Voice AI như Callbot, Voicebot, AI Tutor, Agent Assist, Voice Analytics...
• Hiểu và có kinh nghiệm với audio streaming , VAD, STT-LLM-TTS, Speech-to-Speech.
• Thành thạo các công nghệ realtime như LiveKit, WebRTC, SIP/RTP .
• Có kinh nghiệm training/fine-tuning, đánh giá và tối ưu mô hình giọng nói (ASR/STT, TTS, VAD, Speaker Diarization).
• Có kinh nghiệm model serving, tối ưu inference/GPU và độ trễ AI .
• Quen thuộc RAG, vector database, knowledge retrieval và orchestration với LLM .
• Có kinh nghiệm triển khai trên Kubernetes, Cloud hoặc On-premises .
• Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm trong Ngân hàng, Tài chính, Fintech hoặc Contact Center .

Our corporate culture is nurtured and built on six core values.

With more than 7.000 employees with various positions from back office to front office, we all have our clients and the priority of every position is to gain their reliance and commitment. • Personally write code for the hardest components: agent orchestration core, tool-calling middleware, complex retrieval, guardrail engine and tricky integrations with bank legacy systems.

Mentorship & Code Review
• Run high-quality code reviews that teach failure modes, cost awareness, observability and maintainability — not just check logic.
• Mentor engineers 1-on-1 on technical growth and design decisions.
Stakeholder Representation, R&D and Reliability
• Be the team‘s technical face with Risk, Compliance, IT Infrastructure and Business - translating regulatory and business constraints into design decisions, and technical trade-offs back to stakeholders.
• Drive technical R&D: evaluate emerging techniques, run benchmarks, separate hype from value, and contribute to the division‘s technical roadmap.

• Sở hữu pipeline RAG: Chịu trách nhiệm chất lượng end-to-end cho tài liệu tiếng Việt (văn bản scan, bảng biểu, công văn): parsing/OCR, chunking, embedding, đánh chỉ mục, hybrid search, re-ranking, trích dẫn nguồn — và chứng minh cải tiến bằng số liệu eval.
• Triển khai mô hình on-premise: Trực tiếp triển khai các mô hình open-weight thế hệ mới (DeepSeek V4.1, Qwen3.8, GLM-5.3, gpt-oss…) trên hạ tầng GPU của khách hàng, kể cả môi trường mạng nội bộ hoặc air-gapped.

• Kiến trúc hybrid: Xây model gateway định tuyến giữa mô hình on-premise và cloud theo mức độ nhạy cảm dữ liệu, chi phí và độ trễ.
• Evals và an toàn: Xây bộ dữ liệu test, thiết lập eval tự động trong CI, đo độ chính xác và hallucination; triển khai guardrails, lọc dữ liệu cá nhân, audit log theo yêu cầu an toàn thông tin.

Job description
WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM!
We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to be the senior technical authority for AI across the organization. This is not a people-management role – it’s a consulting and architecture role with organization-wide reach: you design AI solutions, set the standards other engineers build to, drive evaluation discipline, and shape how AI enters our products from the design phase onward. You report directly to the CTO and multiply the impact of every squad working with AI.
What You’ll Do
• Advise and design AI solutions across the full spectrum – from single LLM calls to complex multi-agent infrastructure – recommending implementation approaches that account for fallbacks, cost/latency budgets, and rate-limit constraints (throttling, TPM/RPM).
• Architect agentic systems with the right structure for the problem: MCP server design, deterministic workflows, single agents with tool access, orchestrator–worker or A2A multi-agent topologies.
• Own the evaluation practice that drives technical decisions: eval sets, scoring rubrics, and regression measurement for non-deterministic outputs – and use that evidence to settle when to prompt, when to RAG, when to fine-tune, and when to build an agent, so architecture choices are backed by measurement rather than intuition.
• Partner with Product from the design phase: consult on where AI genuinely adds value in a feature, what’s feasible at what cost, and what the failure modes will look like – so AI capability shapes the product spec instead of being retrofitted after.
• Forecast the direction of AI in the next 2-3 years, and start to take actions today so Perform.AI remains technologically relevant in that future.
• Raise the technical level of engineers across squads: review their designs and code before implementation, define shared standards they follow (prompt conventions, eval-driven development), design and deliver internal AI training programs, and make architecture decisions the whole team builds on.
Your skills and experience
WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG!
Core Qualifications
• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and operating LLM-based systems in production.
• Hands-on experience designing and running LLM-based systems in production – beyond API calls: handling fallbacks, cost/latency trade-offs, rate limits (TPM/RPM), and structured output reliability at scale.
• Experience building multi-step agentic systems and choosing the right topology for the problem – using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, Claude Agents SDK), with working knowledge of MCP, context/state management, and agent failure modes.
• Demonstrated evaluation discipline for non-deterministic systems: building eval sets, defining scoring rubrics (including LLM-as-judge approaches), measuring regression – using tools like LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalents – and using eval evidence to drive architecture decisions (prompt vs. RAG vs. fine-tune vs. agent).
• Strong backend fundamentals with the depth to drive the tech stack, not just work within it: expert-level Python, distributed systems, high-volume data pipelines, and the judgment to select and standardize frameworks, libraries, and infrastructure for AI workloads across the team.
Nice to Have
• Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or other high-volume data domains.
• Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks.
• Experience fine-tuning models (managed fine-tuning APIs or open-weight approaches like LoRA/PEFT) and judging when fine-tuning beats prompting or RAG on cost and quality.
• Experience across the LLM deployment spectrum: working with managed cloud LLM services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent) – quotas, regional availability, model version management – familiarity with deploying open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Qwen from Hugging Face) on your own infrastructure with an understanding of the cost/control trade-offs between the two.

We at Perform.AI are dedicated to being a platform for growth for all our team members, regardless of function and location.

Job description
About Us
We are a cybersecurity company building AI-native security platforms that span both offensive and defensive operations:
• Offensive Platform — An autonomous security platform that uses agentic AI to continuously penetration-test APIs, web applications, and cloud infrastructure. It validates vulnerabilities, chains attack paths, and generates audit-ready reports — all with human-in-the-loop safety
controls.
• Defensive Platform — A role-based AI SOC platform where specialized agents (SOC Manager, Analyst, Incident Response, Threat Hunter) work as a coordinated crew to triage alerts, investigate incidents, hunt threats, and manage Detection-as-Code — at machine speed, under human oversight.
We are not building wrappers around ChatGPT. We are building autonomous, multi-step AI agent systems that reason, plan, use tools, and take real-world action in high-stakes security environments.
The Role
As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and ship the autonomous AI agent systems at the core of our products. Depending on your background and interest, you'll work on one or both of the following:
Offensive Security Agents: You'll build the agent brain that plans multi-step attack strategies, generates auditable configuration files, orchestrates security tool execution (Nmap, Nuclei, Nessus, custom exploits), validates discovered vulnerabilities, and chains minor findings into critical attack paths — all within a human-in-the-loop approval framework.
Defensive Security Agents: You'll build the specialized SOC agents that autonomously triage and correlate alerts, enrich events with contextual data, summarize investigations, propose detection rules, execute threat hunting queries, and recommend incident response actions — while keeping analysts in control of final decisions.
What You'll Do
• Design and implement autonomous agent architectures that handle multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and planning in production security workflows
• Build reliable agent loops with proper error handling, retry logic, guardrails, and human-inthe-loop approval gates for high-risk actions
• Develop dynamic tool-calling pipelines where agents select, configure, and orchestrate external security tools based on contextual analysis
• Engineer prompt chains and agent reasoning strategies across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude) with model-agnostic abstractions
• Build and maintain the context layer that gives agents awareness of users, assets, past incidents, typical behavior, and environmental state
• Design evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety — especially for high-stakes actions like exploit execution or incident response recommendations
• Collaborate with security engineers to translate offensive and defensive domain expertise into agent behavior, tool profiles, and decision logic
• Optimize for latency, cost, and token efficiency in production agent workloads
• Support on-premise deployments using self-hosted open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama) for air-gapped enterprise customers
Your skills and experience
Must Have
• 4+ years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python
• 1+ year of hands-on experience building LLM-powered agent systems — not chatbots, but agents that reason, plan, use tools, and take multi-step actions
• Deep working knowledge of at least one agentic framework: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
• Experience with tool-calling / function-calling patterns, including dynamic tool selection and chaining
• Solid understanding of prompt engineering for complex reasoning tasks — chain-of-thought, ReAct, plan-and-execute patterns
• Experience integrating with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and managing model-agnostic abstractions
• Ability to build robust, production-grade systems — not just prototypes. You think about failure modes, retries, timeouts, guardrails, and observability
• Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, async programming, and API design
Strong Plus
• Background in cybersecurity — offensive (pentesting, vulnerability assessment, red teaming) or defensive (SOC operations, SIEM, detection engineering, incident response)
• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK framework, Sigma rules, or detection-as-code practices
• Experience deploying and fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral) for onpremise or air-gapped environments
• Knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j) for modeling attack paths or entity relationships
• Experience building multi-agent systems where multiple specialized agents collaborate, delegate, and share context
• Familiarity with RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval systems
Mindset
• You're excited about building AI systems that take real action in the world, not just generate text
• You have a strong security intuition — you think about what can go wrong, what an adversary would do, and where guardrails are needed
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and can translate vague domain requirements into concrete agent behaviors
• You care about reliability over cleverness — a working agent that handles edge cases beats a flashy demo
Why you'll love working here

• Direct influence on product architecture and AI strategy from day one
• Work with a team that understands both security and AI deeply
• Competitive compensation

• Workflow Audit & AI Transformation: Analyze processes across departments (Operations, Sales, PM, Engineering, QA) to identify bottlenecks and high-ROI AI opportunities.
• Process Automation & Internal Tools: Build and maintain automated workflows and internal tools connecting email, CRM, Jira, Git, and SaaS platforms, using n8n/Make, Python (FastAPI), and modern UI.

• AI Enablement & R&D: Act as the internal AI champion: train teams, share best practices, and evaluate new models, protocols (MCP), and tools to prototype impactful solutions for Forix.

• Experience: 3+ years in Software/Backend Engineering or Applied AI/Automation, with AI or automation systems in production for real users.

HRS AS A COMPANY
HRS reinvents how businesses Work, Stay and Pay. Counting more than 5.000 corporations and 40 % of Fortune 500 companies in our customer base, HRS has emerged to the most trusted platform of digital software solutions in business travel hospitality worldwide. The HRS platform is composed of three engines that each optimize one core building block along the corporate hospitality supply chain: Intelligent Procurement, Smart Booking and Invisible Payment. Through the integration of those engines into one large data-driven platform approach, our Lodging-as-a-Service value proposition enhances satisfaction of corporate employees and travelers, delivers the highest grade of process automation for corporate stakeholders and ensures strongest compliance end-to-end.
BUSINESS UNIT
Enterprise Solutions is a business unit in HRS which integrates multiple solutions through the interchange of information from various business processes and related databases. Working in Enterprise Solutions means working on our core systems which enable our business processes on a daily basis.
Pay2Reclaim platform is at the core of HRS’s value proposition—simplifying travel payments, automating invoicing, and transforming spend data into actionable insights. Key HRS innovations such as seamless payments, automated invoice validation, fully eligible VAT reclaim, and actionable spend data insights are all powered by the Pay2Reclaim platform.
These capabilities not only drive bottom-line improvements and ensure regulatory compliance for our customers but also play a critical role in enabling HRS’s go-to-market strategy. As Pay adoption grows, it strengthens our global partner ecosystem—unlocking network effects that drive greater value and scalability across the platform. Pay2Reclaim doesn’t just support the travel experience; it powers a strategic financial layer that helps enterprises manage risk, reclaim costs, and optimize spend.
As a member of the Pay2Reclaim teams, you’ll operate at the crossroads of travel and finance, helping some of the world’s leading businesses streamline complex payment flows and gain control over their global travel spend - with visibility, automation, and intelligence at every step.
POSITION

• Báo cáo tiến độ hằng tuần cho Chủ tịch; đề xuất mở rộng đội ngũ khi dự án lớn dần.

Job description
Job Summary: The Cloud FinOps Analyst owns the full FinOps Lifecycle (Inform, Optimize, and Operate) and works very closely with the Information Technology and Finance leadership teams to analytically optimize our Cloud usage within business requirements, leading to maximum cost savings.
Essential Functions:
• Permanent Cost Optimization for all Cloud providers
• Plan, manage and deliver all FinOps projects
• Support the Finance and IT teams at each step of the FinOps Lifecycle
• Create FinOps best practices across the board, with cost optimization, efficiency and stability in mind at all times
• Organize data-driven and proactive financial management of our cloud tenants
• Use analytical techniques to assess spending patterns, identify trends, cost inefficiencies and cost drivers
• Provide billing reports to Finance, related to AWS, Azure and GCP client pass-through costs
• Work with Sales to determine estimated client storage and hosting pass-through costs
• Work with internal departments to determine budgets and monitor spend
• Propose and implement efficient and actionable solutions to all FinOps challenges (including, but not limited to: cost optimization, reservation & plan management, forecasting, usage reporting, cost visibility)
• Effectively communicate with business stakeholders, share analytical findings and proposed solutions to facilitate a common understanding of our current strategies and forecasting.
Your skills and experience
The most successful candidates for this role will have:
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in a similar position
• Demonstrated understanding of FinOps processes, strategies and methods
• Excellent knowledge of Cloud Infrastructures, especially AWS (but Azure and GCP as well)
• Familiar knowledge of cloud cost management tools (such as CloudHealth, Cloudability or others)
• Good understanding of a SaaS platform & business model
• Ability to prioritize, manage projects, and communicate effectively
• Advanced Excel and / or Google Sheets user
• Experience developing systems that improve cost optimization and efficiency
• Growth mindset and interest in giving and receiving feedback with the goal of continuous improvement
• Excellent effectiveness strategies (organization, time management, and follow-up skills)
• Results & detail oriented and committed to operational excellence
• Self-sufficient with the ability to ask questions and request help when needed
Nice to have:
• Prior experience with Google Workspace
• A FinOps certification (Certified Practitioner or other)
AI Fluency
• This role operates in an AI-augmented environment
• We expect fluency in using AI tools to accelerate your own work, and the judgment to critically evaluate and correct AI output rather than take it at face value.
Why you'll love working here
You would love to work and find those values with us:
• Distributed decision making: We also allow each employee to directly weigh in on our priorities.
• Transparency: We value transparency, openness, and accountability, whether it is with our customers or internally.
• Meritocracy: Employee's recognition and advancement is based purely on their individual and collective achievements.
• Deep work: We do everything we can to let you focus deeply on your work.
Our benefits include:
• Attractive salary package and 100% Gross Salary in probation period.
• 13th-month salary.
• 18 days of annual leaves (cashback allowed if not used) plus 4 days for a company trip.
• Multiple allowances (Lunch, Gym, Parking, Birthday/Tet/Wedding voucher... ).
• Full social, health, and unemployment insurance.
• Premium healthcare insurance for you and coverage for 1 extra family member.
• Regular team-building activities (Bowling, Go-Kart, Glamping) and special celebrations on Autumn Festival, Halloween, Christmas, Tet,etc.

Job Summary: The DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for embedding security at every stage of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) - from initial design and development to deployment and operations. This role introduces processes, tools, and methodologies that prioritize secure coding practices, infrastructure hardening, automated compliance, and proactive threat detection, while supporting scalability and continuous delivery in cloud-native environments.
Essential Functions:
• Infrastructure Design & Automation: Design, implement, and maintain secure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) with a focus on compliance, cost efficiency, and security
• Security Integration: Develop and enforce security controls within CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated scanning tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA) to detect vulnerabilities and ensure secure deployments
• Cloud Management: Architect and manage secure cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including containerized workloads with hardened images and Kubernetes security policies
• Monitoring & Incident Response: Implement and manage logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions (e.g., SIEM tools, Prometheus, Grafana) for threat detection and incident response
• Collaboration & Culture: Promote secure development practices, train teams on emerging security methodologies, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure security by design
• Cost Management: Monitor and optimize cloud costs while maintaining security compliance
Your skills and experience
The most successful candidates for this role will have:
• Technical Proficiency: Expertise in IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation), container security (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Security Best Practices: Strong knowledge of security frameworks (OWASP, NIST, CIS) and secure development principles
• Automation & Scripting: Skilled in scripting languages (Bash, Python, PowerShell) for automation and system integration
• System Administration: Solid experience with Linux/Windows hardening and configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet)
• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to promote security best practices and collaborate across teams

• Familiarity with the .NET platform and secure coding practices

Job description
Scandinavian Software Park is the Hanoi-based tech hub and home to several of Scandinavia’s market-leading B2B SaaS companies. Founded and operated by Monterro, the leading B2B software investor in the Nordics, Scandinavian Software Park enables portfolio companies to accelerate growth and build high-end engineering and product capabilities in Vietnam. This role sits within our product services, aiming to delivering expert-level services directly to Monterro’s portfolio of 30+ B2B software companies.
This is a senior individual contributor role for a seasoned security professional who brings deep offensive and defensive expertise and can operate independently across multiple complex engagements. As a Cyber Security Specialist, you will be a key technical authority, leading continuous vulnerability intelligence operations, conducting advanced penetration tests and code security reviews, and advising on the security of AI-powered features across Monterro’s portfolio of Nordic B2B SaaS products. You are also expected to bring the judgment and seniority to triage ambiguous findings, lead threat modeling sessions, support incident response and raise the security maturity of the products you work with.
What you’ll do
Penetration Testing
• Map the environment of each portfolio company, including LLMs, prompts, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, APIs and connected systems, to define a precise attack surface before testing begins.
• Plan and execute full-scope penetration tests against web applications, APIs, and internal systems for portfolio companies, from scoping and reconnaissance through to exploitation and reporting.
• Stress-test system behavior under real-world adversarial conditions, evaluating how models and agents respond to manipulation, privilege abuse, and unexpected inputs.
Red Teaming
• Conduct threat intelligence-led OSINT reconnaissance to map each portfolio company’s digital footprint, identify exposed assets, and define realistic attack scenarios grounded in how real adversaries operate.
• Execute multi-vector attack simulations combining external and internal network exploitation, social engineering, phishing, and lateral movement to reveal how far an attacker could realistically penetrate.
• Run both Full Simulation engagements (end-to-end attack chain from initial access to exfiltration) and Assumed Compromise scenarios (focused on lateral movement and detection/response after access).
• Validate detection and response capabilities: evaluate whether security controls, monitoring, and incident response processes would catch and contain a real attack.
Code-Based Security Review
• Lead in-depth security reviews of application codebases, identifying logic flaws, injection vulnerabilities, broken authentication, insecure data handling and supply-chain risks.
• Apply AI-assisted static analysis alongside manual review techniques to achieve deeper coverage across multiple languages and frameworks.
• Delivery findings with severity ratings, exploitability assessments and precise remediation guidance; present results directly to engineering leads and CTOs.
Threat Modeling
• Lead threat modeling sessions (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent) with portfolio company product and engineering teams during design and architecture phases, not just after the fact.
• Translate threat models into actionable security requirements, test cases, and backlog items that engineering teams can act on.
• Build and maintain threat profiles for portfolio companies, updating them as products evolve and new attack surfaces emerge.
System Security
• Assess the security of AI-powered product features – covering prompt injections, indirect prompt injection, model data leakage, insecure LLM integrations and adversarial input scenarios.
• Stay current on the evolving AI threat landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, emerging jailbreak patterns, supply-chain risks in AI frameworks) and translate findings into practical guidance.
Your skills and experience
What we are looking for
Requirements:
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, penetration testing or vulnerability management.
• Solid experience conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on web applications and APIs with the ability to deliver professional reports independently.
• Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP LLM Top 10, web and API vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization flaws and business logic abuse.
• Experience with red teaming that covers traditional adversarial operations (threat intelligence-led attack planning, OSINT reconnaissance, multi-vector simulations and detection/response validation) and AI-specific targets (LLM jailbreaks, prompt injection, and adversarial testing of generative AI features in production).
• Experience leading threat modeling sessions (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent) with engineering and product teams.
• Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks: prompt injection, model data leakage, insecure LLM integrations and adversarial scenarios.
• Strong code review skills across multiple languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, C#) – able to identify vulnerabilities in unfamiliar codebases independently.
• Experience with AI-assisted or automated security tooling (e.g., Semgrep, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security…) and the judgment to critically evaluate their output.
• Cloud penetration testing experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container/Kubernetes security.
• Understanding of B2B SaaS security patterns: multi-tenancy, OAuth/OIDC, API authentication and cloud-native privilege models.
• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Nice to have
• OSCP, OSWoE, GPEN, GWAPT, or equivalent offensive security certification
• Experience with TIBER-EU or ART (Advanced Red Teaming) frameworks.
• Knowledge of compliance and risk frameworks relevant to Nordic/European software companies: ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2.
• Prior experience working with B2B SaaS or Nordic/European software companies is a strong plus
