About Flexspace AI
• Flexspace AI is the e-commerce + AI revenue platform for coworking — / Shopify / Airbnb for flexible workspace. Seed-funded. We turn operators' websites into high-converting storefronts and run AI agents that price and market their inventory in real time.
• What we ship : mobile-first booking engine that embeds in any operator's site; SmartPricing Agent for dynamic pricing on meeting rooms, day passes, offices; SmartMarketing Agent for promo campaigns; operator dashboard for revenue/bookings/attribution; member portal for end customers; two-way integrations with prominent property management systems.
• Who buys it : coworking operators from single-location indies to multi-country brands. Their revenue is the conversion rate of the screens you'll design — CTAs, catalog, transitions, and checkout aren't decoration here; they're the product.
• How we work : small, agile, AI-heavy. On track to profitability this year. Headcount is deliberately small so each person owns real surface area — tight feedback loops, no bureaucracy, no committees. We measure shipped work — funnel lifts, partner themes shipped, UX issues triaged — not hours. No face-time theater.
• Co-located hybrid out of Workflow Thao Dien in HCMC for in-person speed. Wider team is async-first, written-first across US, Israel, Turkey, Philippines, and Vietnam. Weekly product/design sync with the CTO/cofounder — no layers between you and the people deciding what to build.
Role Overview
Product Engineer building the e-commerce platform behind the next generation of coworking spaces—SmartPricing, SmartMarketing, the booking engine operators embed on their sites, and the integrations that tie it all together. You work directly with the founders, with no layers between you and the people setting the roadmap. We also welcome final-year students looking for an internship.
• What engineering means here. The hard problem isn't writing code—AI writes plenty of it now. It's deciding what's worth building. Operators juggle hundreds of spaces, prices, members, bookings, and integrations across locations and time zones; customers comparing meeting rooms decide in seconds. Your job is to understand these humans—in the data—then ship software that moves their revenue. Empathy and data are the input; working product is the output. Polish comes last.
• On prioritization. Not all code has the same payoff. You'll look at a problem from several angles—funnel data, operator feedback, revenue, churn signals—and pick the work where your hours move the business most. A feature nobody uses is wasted hours; a 2% lift on the booking funnel is the company's quarter. Judgment over completeness.
• On decisions. Bigger calls go to the team before you build. Smaller calls—ship, watch the data, iterate. We're data-driven, not opinion-driven, and seniority doesn't win arguments—evidence does. You'll own the surfaces you touch, with support, and you expose your reasoning so we can calibrate together.
• On growth. You're early-career, and we hire for that on purpose. Expect code review, pairing, and direct coaching from founders and senior engineers. We can teach the stack, the patterns, and the product thinking. The one thing we can't give you is drive—that comes from you.
What You'll Do
• Ship features end-to-end. Work with founders and operators to understand a need, then spec, build, and release it—with support along the way.
• Build and evolve our SmartPricing & SmartMarketing agents. Pricing rules, targeting logic, and performance monitoring.
• Make booking effortless. Seamless booking experiences with instant payment, embedded right in operators' websites.
• Wire up integrations. Sync data with coworking CRMs, inventory systems, and analytics tools—and prevent double bookings.
• Pull data, form an opinion, decide. Revenue, Mixpanel, GA4 / GTM funnel data, and operator feedback.
• Write so the team stays in sync. Clear specs and pull-request descriptions that keep an async, distributed team aligned across time zones.
How You'll Work With AI
Claude as peers, not novelties. You'll write and refine structured prompts, build new ones, and ship real changes through AI tools. Senior engineers coach you and set guardrails so you can move fast without first becoming a framework expert. Judgment, taste, and clear thinking are the bottleneck now—not syntax. We give you a budget for the best AI tools because we expect you to use them as leverage, not as a crutch.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
• You've shipped real features to production that operators and members actually use.
• You can navigate the codebase and pick up unfamiliar areas without much hand-holding.
• You ship changes through Claude with sound judgment about what to accept and what to rework.
• You back your decisions and pushback with data—and your written updates keep the async team moving without meetings.
• You're catching product, UX, and trade-off issues early, not just implementing tickets.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We prioritize these qualities top-down—technical skills can be learned quickly by sharp, curious people with low ego and a strong work ethic. Above all, here's what we look for:
• Drive and motivation. We can give you the tools, the environment, and hands-on coaching—but we can't give you the drive to succeed as a product engineer in the modern AI era. That has to come from you.
• Attention to detail and high standards. You're obsessed with quality—it's not about just getting the job done, it's about delivering the best work you can and raising the team's bar. You sweat the small things—edge cases, copy, data correctness—because details separate a working product from a trusted one.
• Clear written English. You read and write clear English (with the help with AI tools); in an async, globally distributed team, your writing is how you think, collaborate, and lead.
• High agency. You take initiative—ask questions when something's unclear, chase down answers, and push your work forward instead of waiting to be told the next step.
• You question everything. Everyone has a voice and is expected to push the envelope. There's no "the senior person knows better"—answers and pushback alike are grounded in data and critical thinking, regardless of title or age.
• Curiosity and fast learning. You pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly, especially around AI, pricing, and B2B SaaS.
• Product sense. You care about customers and business context, not just the tech stack, and you treat engineering as a way to drive revenue, bookings, and occupancy. You grasp basic microeconomics—incentives, opportunity cost, supply and demand—as a toolkit for trade-offs: simpler designs that still maximize value, arguments made in terms of impact rather than opinion, and an understanding of why the business prioritizes what it does. Don't have this thinking framework yet? If you bring the motivation, we'll coach you on it.

• Solid CS fundamentals. You understand how data is structured, how APIs work, and how to troubleshoot methodically—and you can name what you're doing and why.

Job description
About the job
Product Engineer
• AI-first engineering, uncompromising fundamentals. Accountable for the outcome, not the output.
• Full-time · On-site · Flexible working hours · Distributed, multi-timezone team · AI-first engineering · 3+ years experience
• The role is remote from your start date and becomes hybrid when our new office opens, expected around 20 December
Job Summary
We are hiring a Product Engineer - an engineer accountable for outcomes, not output .
We do not measure engineers by tickets closed or lines shipped. We measure them by whether the thing they built actually solved the user's problem. That means you will be expected to question requirements before building them, own a feature from ambiguity through to production behaviour, and stay attached to it after release - watching the metrics, the logs, and the support tickets.
You will work with Product Managers, designers, and business stakeholders based in different countries and timezones . Overlap hours are limited by design, so clear communication and the ability to move a decision forward asynchronously - without waiting for a meeting - matter as much as your engineering skill.
This is a deeply technical role with an AI-first mindset . AI coding agents are the default way we build here - you will spend more of your day designing architecture, steering agents, and reviewing generated code than typing implementations by hand. We expect fluency with spec-driven development, reusable agent skills, and context engineering, not occasional autocomplete use. Which is exactly why fundamentals and best practices matter more, not less , so you will be held to a high bar on SOLID, Clean Architecture, design patterns, distributed system design, relational data modelling, and automation testing: these are working knowledge, not résumé keywords, and you should expect to defend your choices reasonably in code review and in the interview.
You remain the author of record for everything that lands in main. "The agent wrote it" is never an acceptable explanation for a defect.
Key Responsibilities
• Own the outcome. Take a business problem from vague to shipped to measured . Define what success looks like with your Product Manager, instrument for it, and act on what the data says - including rolling back or rewriting your own work when the numbers disagree with the plan.
• Find the problem, not just the solution. Interrogate requirements before implementing them. Surface the cheaper path, the edge case nobody scoped, and the feature that shouldn't be built. Say so early and in writing.
• Collaborate across borders and timezones. Partner directly with Product Managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders distributed across multiple countries. Write decisions down, keep specs and PR descriptions self-explanatory, unblock people in other timezones, and run the occasional early or late call when the others need it.
• Architect and build services and APIs. Design RESTful (and where appropriate, event-driven or gRPC) services applying SOLID, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, and design patterns deliberately - with a clear justification for the boundaries you draw. Design normalised, indexed, migration-safe relational schemas that hold up under real query load. Architecture is the part an agent cannot infer for you: you set the boundaries and the contracts, then let agents fill them in.
• Design for distribution. Make grounded calls on monolith vs. microservices. Build services that satisfy 12-factor principles - externalised config, stateless processes, disposability, dev/prod parity - and containerise them for Docker/Kubernetes deployment.
• Automate the safety net. Own automated testing for what you build: unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where it earns its keep. Tests ship in the same PR as the code, not in a follow-up ticket. A bug fix without a reproducing test is not a fix. In an AI-first workflow the test suite is the specification - it is what makes agent-generated change safe to merge at speed.
• Work AI-first, and hold the line on quality. Drive delivery with coding agents, know your acceptance criteria first, let agents execute, then review hard. Build and maintain reusable agent skills, project instructions, and guardrails so the whole team gains leverage - not just your own throughput. Reject output that is merely plausible: over-abstracted layers, duplicated logic, silently swallowed errors, tests that assert nothing. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
• Run what you ship. Instrument services with structured logging, metrics, and tracing. Debug production incidents, write the postmortem, and close the loop with a fix that prevents recurrence.
• Raise the team's bar. Review peers' PRs substantively, document trade-offs and decisions, and mentor on fundamentals and on responsible AI-assisted workflows.
Your skills and experience
Job Requirements
• 3+ years building and operating production backend services - and you can walk through a system you designed, why you designed it that way, and what you'd change now.
• Deep, demonstrable command of software design fundamentals: OOP, SOLID, Clean Architecture, and design patterns. You will be asked to critique a design and explain what breaks at scale. This is the non-negotiable core of the role - in an AI-first team, fundamentals are the review capability that keeps agent velocity from becoming agent debt.
• Strong RESTful API design: resource modelling, versioning, idempotency, pagination, error contracts, authentication/authorisation.
• Strong relational database design (PostgreSQL/MySQL): normalisation and when to break it, indexing strategy, transactions and isolation levels, query analysis, safe schema migrations.
• Microservices and 12-factor apps: service boundaries, inter-service communication, failure isolation, configuration and secrets management - plus honest judgment on when a monolith is the correct answer.
• Automation testing discipline: you write tests first or alongside, understand the test pyramid, and use test doubles without mocking away the thing under test. You treat coverage as a floor for confidence, never as a number to satisfy - and you can tell a genuine regression test from an agent-generated one that asserts nothing.
• Containerisation: confident with Docker; working knowledge of Kubernetes (deployments, services, config/secrets, health probes, resource limits).
• An AI-first way of working, already in your hands: real production experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent - including spec/context engineering, agent skills or custom commands, and a disciplined self-review process before any PR. You should be able to describe a time an agent produced plausible-but-wrong code, how you caught it, and which fundamental (a design principle, a data-model rule, a failing test) let you catch it.
• Product mindset with real ownership instincts: comfortable with ambiguity, able to talk to non-engineers about trade-offs in their language, and biased toward shipping something small to learn rather than debating something large.
• Effective asynchronous, cross-cultural collaboration: professional written English, the discipline to document context for people who are asleep when you're working, and comfort operating with stakeholders in several countries and timezones.
• Working frontend ability - React, Next.js, or Vue - enough to build and ship a full user-facing slice yourself.
Nice to Have
• Golang - our preferred backend language for new services.
• gRPC and HTTP/2 , including streaming and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time and AI-streaming interfaces.
• ReactJS / NextJS at depth - SSR/RSC, routing, data fetching, performance.
• CI/CD pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) including automated quality and security gates.
• Infrastructure as Code - Terraform, Pulumi, or Helm.
• Service observability and SRE practice - OpenTelemetry, APM (Datadog / New Relic / Grafana stack), SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident response.
• Message queues, background job processing, and event-driven architectures.
• SaaS products, media streaming (HLS/M3U8), or prior experience in a distributed international team.
Why you'll love working here
What We Offer
• Office pantry, adjustable height desk, monitors, entertaining area, etc at office.
• Flexible working hours - we care when your work lands and how it performs, not when you were online.
• A genuinely international team - you'll work with product and business colleagues across multiple countries.
• Team building activities and company trips.

Job description
ROLE OVERVIEW
• We are looking for a proactive, skilled, and detail-oriented Python AI Cloud Engineer – Azure (Middle) with 3 to 5 years of commercial software engineering experience to expand our Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate Python serverless workflows on Azure Durable Functions and production AI agents on Microsoft Foundry and LangGraph, running inside a complex, network-isolated enterprise Azure landing zone.
• You will own long-running orchestrations, agentic workflows, and event-driven integrations end to end, connecting internal enterprise tools, Microsoft 365, and our central SAP ERP system. You will build the agent harness around our models (tools, memory, guardrails, evaluation, and observability) and work hands-on with the infrastructure underneath it all: hub-and-spoke virtual networks, private endpoints, hybrid connectivity to on-premises systems, identity, and governance.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Durable Functions Development: Design and build Python workflows on Azure Functions and Durable Functions (orchestrator, activity, and entity functions) using patterns such as function chaining, fanout/fan-in, async HTTP APIs, monitors, and human interaction, with idempotent activities, retry policies, and safe versioning of long-running orchestrations.
• Backend & API Development: Build and maintain Python services and REST APIs (FastAPI, Azure Functions HTTP triggers) exposed through Azure API Management, with typed, tested, and documented code (type hints, Pydantic, OpenAPI).
• AI Agents & Agent Harness: Design and operate production AI agents with LangGraph and Microsoft Foundry (Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI and other Foundry models), including the agent harness around them: tool / function calling against internal and SAP APIs, MCP servers, state and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, and durable long-running agent execution on Durable Functions.
• RAG, Evaluation & Responsible AI: Build retrieval pipelines on Azure AI Search (hybrid / vector search, chunking, embeddings), set up offline and online evaluations and tracing in Foundry, and apply guardrails (Azure AI Content Safety, prompt-injection defenses, data-access boundaries); manage model deployments, quotas, latency, and token cost through private, Entra ID-secured Foundry endpoints.
• Cloud Infrastructure & Networking: Provision and operate a complex Azure landing zone with Bicep or Terraform: hub-and-spoke VNets, subnets and NSGs, Private Endpoints and Private DNS zones, VNet integration for Functions Premium / Flex Consumption plans, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway / Front Door with WAF, and hybrid connectivity (VPN Gateway / ExpressRoute) to on-premises systems, applying Azure Well-Architected Framework principles.
• Security, Identity & Governance: Secure workloads with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Azure Policy; enforce least-privilege access and private-only connectivity across subscriptions and environments.
• SAP & Enterprise Integration: Design, deploy, and monitor integration pipelines connecting internal applications to SAP S/4HANA / ECC and Microsoft 365 via OData (v2/v4), REST APIs, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Logic Apps.
• CI/CD, Quality & Observability: Build and maintain Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments (environment promotion, staged / slot-based rollouts); maintain high test coverage with pytest; and implement structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.

Must-have
• Python: Strong commercial experience with modern Python (3.10+), including asyncio, type hints, packaging and dependency management (uv, Poetry, or pip), and testing with pytest.

• Azure Infrastructure & Networking: Proven experience setting up and troubleshooting non-trivial Azure environments (VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, VNet integration, routing and firewalls, hybrid connectivity) using infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform.
• API Design & Integration: Proven track record in designing, documenting (OpenAPI/Swagger), consuming, and securing RESTful APIs, webhooks, and message-based integrations (Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage queues).
• Databases: Strong practical experience with relational databases (Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL), schema migrations (e.g., Alembic), query performance tuning, and Python data access (SQLAlchemy, pyodbc, or psycopg).
Nice-to-have

• Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).

🎯 Position Summary
• Are you a natural storyteller who loves creating content that resonates with real audiences? Are you also curious about how AI can help you work faster and think bigger? We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented individual to join our team as an AI Research & Content Generator — a content-first role where AI tools are your everyday assistant, not the main focus.
• In this role, you will plan and produce a wide variety of content for Athena's games and brand — from social media posts, short videos, marketing copy, and community content to blog articles and in-game text. You'll use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and CapCut AI to speed up ideation, drafting, and production, while your own creative judgment, writing skills, and understanding of our audience remain the heart of every piece you ship. If you love writing, storytelling, and gaming culture — and see AI as a superpower rather than a subject — we want to hear from you.
🧠 Key Responsibilities
• Content Creation & Storytelling: Write, produce, and refine content across multiple formats — social media posts (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Discord), marketing copy, blog articles, community announcements, store-listing content, and in-game text — that reflects Athena's tone and connects with our players.
• Brand Voice & Editorial Judgment: Ensure every piece of content sounds like Athena — consistent, engaging, and audience-appropriate. Make the final call on what's good enough to publish and what needs another pass.
• AI-Assisted Production: Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, etc.) as your everyday assistant to speed up brainstorming, drafting, image mockups, video editing, and translation — always with a human eye on the final output.
• Content Planning: Contribute to the content calendar, propose ideas tied to game launches, events, community moments, and pop-culture trends. Turn briefs from Marketing and Game teams into ready-to-publish assets on time.
• Audience & Trend Research: Stay close to our players and the wider gaming community. Track what's resonating on social, in Discord — and translate those insights into better content.
• Light Performance Tracking: Review basic metrics (views, engagement, shares, comments) to understand what works and what doesn't. Use those learnings to improve the next round of content.
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Community, Art, and Game Design teams. Take direction, share drafts early, incorporate feedback quickly, and keep everyone in the loop.
Your skills and experience
• Strong Writing Skills: Excellent writing in Vietnamese (native-level) and English (Upper-Intermediate or higher). You can shift tone between engaging store-listing content based on given keywords (including App Name/Title, Description, and Visual Assets, etc.), playful social captions, professional press releases, and heartfelt community messages.
• Storytelling Instinct: A natural sense for what makes a story, a post, or a video actually engaging — not just informative. You've probably been writing, posting, or creating in some form for a while, even if just for fun.

Please share any content you've made — blog posts, social accounts you run, fanfiction, short videos, gaming reviews, Facebook Pages, TikToks, community posts, etc. We care about your voice and creativity more than your job title.

MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC:
Tại ETP TESOL, chúng tôi ứng dụng công nghệ và Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) vào toàn bộ quy trình vận hành và đào tạo. Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một Kỹ sư Tích hợp Hệ thống. Bạn sẽ sử dụng các mô hình AI Code tiên tiến nhất làm một đội ngũ trợ lý ảo để coding, trong khi bản thân bạn đóng vai trò thiết kế kiến trúc, cấu hình hạ tầng, gỡ lỗi và ghép nối các module hệ thống lại với nhau để tăng hiệu suất công việc.
1. Tích hợp Hệ thống & Tự động hóa (System Integration & Automation)
• Thiết kế và duy trì các luồng tự động hóa dữ liệu kết nối giữa nhiều hệ thống: Quản lý khách hàng (CRM), Quản lý học tập (LMS), Quản lý nhân sự (HRM) và Marketing.
• Phát triển API và Webhooks để đồng bộ hóa dữ liệu thời gian thực giữa các kênh giao tiếp đa nền tảng (Omnichannel / Social Chat) và hệ thống tổng đài nội bộ.
2. Tùy biến Nền tảng Core (CRM, LMS, CMS)
• Nghiên cứu và phát triển các module mở rộng, tính năng tùy chỉnh trên các nền tảng mã nguồn mở (Open-source CRM, Open-source LMS) phục vụ riêng cho nghiệp vụ giáo dục và đào tạo.
• Quản trị, bảo trì và tối ưu hóa hiệu suất cho hệ thống nội bộ.
3. Phát triển Ứng dụng Nội bộ & Scripting
• Xây dựng các công cụ, ứng dụng web (Web Apps) quản trị học vụ và vận hành.
• Viết các script tự động hóa các tác vụ hành chính thủ công (ví dụ: tự động xử lý và định dạng hàng loạt tài liệu học thuật, phân quyền truy cập tài nguyên tự động).
4. Quản trị Hạ tầng cơ bản (DevOps & Server)
• Triển khai ứng dụng theo hướng đóng gói trên môi trường máy chủ Linux VPS.
• Quản lý định tuyến web, tên miền, chứng chỉ bảo mật và theo dõi sức khỏe hệ thống.
Your skills and experience
• Tốt nghiệp Đại Học ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin
• Tối thiểu 2 năm kinh nghiệm liên quan.
• Tư duy & Kỹ năng cốt lõi (Quan trọng nhất):
• AI-First Mindset: Có kỹ năng Prompt Engineering xuất sắc. Thành thạo việc sử dụng các công cụ AI hỗ trợ lập trình (như Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, v.v.) để viết code, refactor code, và rà soát logic.
• System Thinking: Tư duy nhạy bén về luồng dữ liệu (Data flow) và thiết kế API. Nhìn hệ thống một cách tổng thể, biết cách lắp ghép các giải pháp có sẵn thay vì tự viết lại (reinvent the wheel).
• Nền tảng kỹ thuật:
• Nắm vững kiến trúc phần mềm và hệ thống cơ sở dữ liệu.
• Thành thạo JavaScript/TypeScript (cho cả Frontend và Backend).
• Có khả năng đọc hiểu, gỡ lỗi và tùy biến mã nguồn PHP (Rất cần thiết để can thiệp vào các nền tảng mã nguồn mở).
• Có khả năng sử dụng Python ở mức độ scripting, tự động hóa quy trình hoặc thao tác với API.
• Sử dụng thành thạo Linux command line cơ bản, Web Server, và công cụ quản lý Container (như Docker).

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Technical Architect to design a large-scale platform spanning multiple products, business domains, and shared services, with strong requirements for software quality, reliability, security, and scalability.
The project follows an AI-first approach across analysis, architecture, review, and implementation. The Technical Architect structures work for AI-assisted execution while retaining ownership of architectural decisions and validating the quality of all deliverables.
Key Responsibilities:
• Analyze business domains and define service boundaries, data ownership, and cross-service dependencies.
• Review business and technical contracts to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before detailed design.
• Design service, database, API, event, and integration architectures, ensuring shared capabilities are reused across products.
• Produce architecture specifications and implementation contracts that enable developers and AI coding agents to implement solutions consistently.
• Design for scalability, security, resilience, observability, testing, and deployment appropriate to each delivery phase.
• Apply AI-first workflows through structured context, task decomposition, reusable skills, and validation gates.
• Review AI-generated documentation and code for architectural compliance and traceability to requirements, contracts, and approved decisions.
• Guide developers and collaborate with Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, and Security teams.
• Assess the impact of changes to requirements, contracts, and architecture.
Your skills and experience
Requirements:
• At least 7 years of software development experience , including 2 years as a Technical Architect, Solution Architect, or in an equivalent architectural role .
• Hands-on experience designing and delivering production systems, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, trade-offs, and outcomes.
• Strong knowledge of DDD, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, and contract-first design.
• Solid understanding of data modeling, transaction boundaries, consistency, concurrency, idempotency, and failure handling.
• Experience designing multi-tenant systems with complex integrations, high availability, and horizontal scalability.
• Strong backend engineering experience with Java/Kotlin, Spring Boot, relational databases, messaging, and API design.
• Working knowledge of cloud architecture, containers, CI/CD, observability, security, and disaster recovery.
• Practical experience using AI tools for technical work and willingness to follow an AI-first development workflow .
• Ability to validate AI outputs against authoritative sources, architecture reviews, and automated tests, and identify unsupported assumptions or conclusions.

• Experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, OpenAPI, and Kubernetes.

Mo_Ta_Cong_Viec:
Job description
• Support users in using and operating Odoo and other company software.
• Develop new software applications and tools to meet departmental requirements.
• Work directly with users across departments to gather software development requirements, analyze business processes, and propose solutions to management.
• Develop and customize Odoo modules to meet business needs.
• Modify existing features and develop additional functionality in Odoo to support the workflows of Elasten, Citeco, and business units in Germany.
• Prepare user documentation, conduct training, and guide users on Odoo and other company software.
• Investigate and troubleshoot software issues, and update or correct data when errors occur.
• Prepare individual work plans and reports, and evaluate personal work performance.
• Propose initiatives to improve work quality and productivity.
• Perform other duties as assigned by the direct manager.
Your skills and experience
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in IT, Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of software development experience, including 3 years in Odoo development/customization, with a lead or key role in at least 2 enterprise Odoo implementation projects.
• Proficiency in Python, PostgreSQL, and the Odoo framework, including ORM, QWeb, XML views, workflows, security, and reporting.
• Strong understanding of Odoo architecture and core modules: Accounting, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing, and HR; experience with Odoo implementation or upgrades.
• Knowledge of business analysis, system design, and third-party API/web service integration.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, advanced Excel, and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot for coding, analysis, and daily work.
• Ability to read technical documentation in English and communicate at a basic level.
• Strong requirements gathering, problem-solving, communication, presentation, training, documentation, and cross-department collaboration skills.
• Honest, proactive, responsible, decisive, and detail-oriented; able to work independently, manage competing requests under pressure, and maintain data confidentiality.
• A systematic, solution-oriented approach, strong professional ethics, willingness to learn, and commitment to a long-term role.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Graduates of Hanoi University of Science and Technology, VNU University of Engineering and Technology, or Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology.
• Odoo certification or experience with an Odoo implementation partner.
• Familiarity with JavaScript/OWL, HTML/CSS, Git, Linux, and Docker.
• Experience developing internal tools, working in multi-company/multi-branch environments, or supporting manufacturing/trading businesses and their accounting, inventory, and sales processes.
Why you'll love working here

Job description
Role Summary
We are looking for experienced and forward‑thinking Technical Leads – Backend to lead the design and development of backend services for large‑scale digital banking and financial platforms.
The role requires strong expertise in system architecture and design, microservices backend engineering, and understanding of banking / financial service domains, along with the ability to lead engineering teams and communicate confidently with client stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure and high-quality backend solutions.
In today’s engineering ecosystem, AI assistants are integral to the Software Development Lifecycle. Engineers, including this role, are expected to leverage AI tools for code generation, test creation, and refactoring, while focusing their expertise on architecture, system thinking, code verification, security, quality assurance, and strategic technical decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership
• Lead and mentor a team of backend engineers across multiple functional domains.
• Provide technical direction and ensure alignment with architecture standards and engineering best practices.
• Review solution designs, code quality, and implementation approaches — promoting clean architecture, resilient microservices, and AI‑enhanced development patterns.
• Guide the team in diagnosing complex technical challenges, using both traditional analysis and AI-powered debugging or observability tools.
• Support planning, estimation, and technical decision-making within the engineering team.
Backend Architecture & Development
• Design and develop backend services using Java and modern backend frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot).
• Define and implement microservices-based architecture and API-driven systems.
• Ensure backend services are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable.
• Drive best practices in backend development, including maintainable system design, automated testing, code quality, API governance, performance optimization and documentation.
• Work closely with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines, incorporate intelligent automation, and ensure stable, secure deployment environments.
• Integrate AI-assisted development practices into coding, testing, documentation, code reviews, and defect prevention workflows.
Banking & Payment Domain
• Design backend systems supporting banking products and financial transaction processing.
• Build and maintain services related to payments, card processing, financial operations, and core banking functions.
• Ensure backend implementations comply with financial industry standards and security requirements.
• Collaborate with business and product teams to translate banking and financial requirements into technical solutions.
• Client Collaboration & Delivery
• Work directly with client stakeholders, architects, and product owners to understand business processes, requirements and define technical solutions.
• Challenge and clarify requirements with curiosity dig deep into the "why" behind business needs.
• Participate in architecture discussions and technical workshops with client teams.
• Communicate technical designs, trade-offs, and solutions clearly to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.
• Support project delivery by ensuring technical risks are identified and mitigated early.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 8+ years of backend development experience.
• 3+ years in a Technical Lead or senior engineering role.
• Strong experience with Java and backend frameworks (e.g. Spring Boot).
• Experience designing and implementing microservices, API-driven systems, event-driven architectures or messaging systems (e.g., Kafka), RDBMS and SQL.
• Solid experience working with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Strong understanding of CI/CD, version control (Git), and automated pipelines.
• Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Specific Qualifications

• Fluent English communication.

• Ability to write effective prompts and context for AI code generation.
• Ability to assess AI-generated code, verify security vulnerabilities, validate AI-generated tests for completeness and edge case coverage.

Job description
About the Role
You will own bonbon shop, our B2B platform connecting brands with retail outlets. That means owning the backlog, the requirements, and what gets shipped. You will work closely with the Product Manager on the product’s direction and on key decisions with enterprise clients.
Every enterprise client runs their business differently, and each will ask for things the product can’t do yet. We see these requests as the best source of insight into what the product should become. If you enjoy turning real client problems into product capabilities, you will thrive here.
How this role runs
• Outcomes over output. The roadmap is measured by activation, retention, and revenue, not by how many features we ship.
• Data drives priorities. We decide what to build based on usage data: funnels, session recordings, and where users drop off.
• AI where it matters. We apply AI to workflows with heavy manual effort, and keep simple flows simple.
• Build once, serve many. When a client asks for something, your job is to turn it into a capability that other clients can use too.
Key Responsibilities
1. Roadmap and Backlog
• Own the roadmap across activation, engagement, retention, and monetization
• Own and prioritize the product backlog by value, data, and business impact
• Set the success metric for every initiative before work begins
2. Client Requirements and Platform Decisions
• Serve multiple enterprise clients with different ways of working on one platform, without splitting the product into separate versions
• Turn repeated requests into configuration. Build the flexibility before the third client asks for it
• Propose what becomes a platform capability, what becomes configuration, and what gets declined
• Keep client commitments and roadmap work both on schedule
3. Trade Marketing and Brand Programs
• Own the part of the product that lets Trade Marketing and Marketing run programs directly with retailers: loyalty mechanics, promotion execution, sell-out campaigns, brand activation at outlet level
• Give brand managers a clear view of program performance, including whether retailer behavior changed
• Work with Sales and Professional Services (PS) to find where programs break in the field, and fix the cause in the product
4. Data, Behavior and AI
• Own the product analytics: funnels, cohorts, activation events, drop-off points, and add the events we are missing
• Run experiments, watch session recordings, talk to users in the field, and write down what you learned
• Find the repetitive, low-value steps done by retailers, sales reps, and brand teams, and propose AI-assisted alternatives
5. Working with the Teams
• Spend around 30% of your time with clients: meetings, workshops, and field visits, including travel outside HCMC
• Set expectations with clients, Sales, Trade Marketing, and management on what ships, when, and what does not
• With Project Managers: the PM decides project scope and timeline, you decide the product. Raise conflicts early
• With R&D (BA and development team): own requirements, priorities, and acceptance. Drive Agile delivery by running the sprint and ceremonies yourself
Your skills and experience
• 3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Senior BA on a B2B software product, managing and prioritizing the backlog across discovery, delivery, and iteration in an Agile/Scrum environment
• Experience in distribution, retail, FMCG, pharma, or Trade Marketing program execution , with working knowledge of multi-tier distribution (brand → distributor → retailer) and how trade promotions are funded, run, and measured
• Writes clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from with minimal clarification
• Comfortable balancing conflicting requirements from multiple enterprise clients, both in meetings and on field visits to distributors and retailers
• Able to read product data and act on it: funnels, cohorts, drop-off points, and the results of simple experiments.

• Experience building AI features into a shipped product
• Familiarity with OMS, POS, DMS, or similar platforms

Job description
As Technical Product Manager, you keep the stream focused on outcomes that matter for customers, partners and the business. You take charge of product and technology direction within the stream, and you make sure that what we build is actually used and actually creates value.
You will be the regular technical contact for customers and partners, the person who carries their reality into the stream and carries the stream's direction back out.
This is a bridge role that holds real weight. You’ll work shoulder to shoulder with our Product Managers to align product vision, value, and technology in the stream backlog, and you’ll be a full member of the stream. Here, leadership means clarity: every initiative has a clear, measurable and traceable outcome. The team's autonomy is built on the confidence that they are doing the right thing under the supervision of the Technical Product Manager.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
Shape the direction
• Set product and technology direction for the stream, giving every initiative a clear target outcome.
• Explore new technical possibilities, including through agentic research, and bring concrete options to the team.
• Frame hard technical questions, explore options and steer the team toward sound decisions.
• Co-own the stream backlog with the PMs. Keep it shaped, prioritized and connected to outcomes, with the customer and partner view always present.
Build and run it
• Shape features and write technical specifications, using AI-assisted techniques to turn problems into clear, buildable plans.
• Implement features end to end across the relevant layer of the stack, following Magnolia’s development policies and quality standards.
• Live the “you build it, you run it, you take charge” mindset as a regular member of the stream.
• Run our product solutions together with the platform, cloud and support teams.
Be the voice of the customer
• Act as the technical contact for customers and partners. Understand their context and turn it into product direction.
• Handle 3rd level support topics and communication, sometimes working directly with customers.
• Take part in PD on-call duties in an advisory role, with a focus on on-premise installations.
Drive adoption and impact
• Track whether features are used and create value, and act when they don’t.
• Enable go-to-market so features reach customers and partners well, including internal enablement and training.
• Work across streams and departments, such as support, training, customer success, professional services and cloud, to keep direction and delivery connected.
• Collaborate proactively and constructively with your team, your department and the wider company.
Your skills and experience
Must-Have Qualifications
• Strong critical thinking, a collaborative spirit and a take-charge mentality.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with colleagues and with internal and external stakeholders.
• Ability to enable and train technical people on your own topics.
• Solid technical system design and solution thinking.
• Experience in technical shaping and specification of product solutions using agentic flows.
• Hands-on engineering skills across frontend (REACT, Typescript, node.js), backend (J2EE, micro services) and platform (Cloud and Container based environments).
• A strong quality mindset, with experience in unit, integration, performance and platform testing.
• Leadership skills without formal authority, guiding through influence and clarity.
• Full accountability for your own work and solutions.
• Competencies in secure development, threat modelling, vulnerability handling, data protection and related standards (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2).
• Proficient English, written and spoken.
SO, WHO ARE WE?
• Bright, fun, and open-minded colleagues spread across the globe
• Lateral and vertical growth opportunities
• Flexible, innovative and outcome-oriented
• Aside from work, we are parents, gamers, bookworms, athletes, adrenaline junkies, philosophers, and so much more.
WE ARE FOR YOU IF YOU LIKE TO…
• take charge : Everyone at Magnolia is in the driver’s seat and we set the direction according to what our customers, colleagues and culture need. No matter the roadblocks you see ahead, you take charge in (re)shaping the destination.
• connect : You never drive alone. Building meaningful connections means creating experiences together that form a foundation of trust so next time there’s a bump in the road, you know someone else has your back
• be you : Choose your own ways and means. We thrive on making every perspective count so that you feel safe enough to follow your purpose and at the same time pursue one common goal. Our way of growing is to mutually question ourselves and others.
Why you'll love working here
Personal Development Opportunities: We believe in nurturing individual growth and happiness. As part of our commitment, we provide a range of indoor and outdoor training activities, including technical courses, English classes, and soft skills training.
Comprehensive Health Coverage: Your well-being and that of your family are paramount to us. We cover 100% of healthcare premiums for all employees and their dependents, ensuring you can access quality medical care without financial worries.
Employee and Family Care: At Magnolia, we extend our care beyond the workplace. From health insurance to organizing summer vacations and family events like Family Day, Children's Day, and the Mid-Autumn Festival, we prioritize the well-being and happiness of our employees and their families. Additionally, enjoy recreational activities such as football, swimming, bowling, cinema, and more.
Competitive Salary and Benefits: Your hard work deserves recognition. Our compensation package includes:
• An attractive salary, a 13th-month salary, seniority bonuses, and opportunities for career advancement.
• Annual leave of up to 21 days;
• Regular exchange programs to Switzerland for two weeks, twice a year.
Flexible Working Hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy flexibility in your schedule.
Employee Perks: Your comfort and satisfaction matter to us. Our office is stocked with beverages, fruits, and snacks, and we provide meals every evening. Join us on "Whoopee Fridays" for team-building activities, knowledge exchange sessions, and lively conversations.

Position Overview:
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the software engineering team responsible for the development and continuous improvement of the HI GIO CLOUD Portal.
The role focuses on people management, delivery ownership, engineering execution, and continuous improvement. The Engineering Manager will work closely with the Architect and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into actionable plans and ensure successful delivery.
Key Responsibilities
1. People Management
• Directly manage, coach, and develop software engineers through goal setting, regular feedback, and performance reviews.
• Manage team priorities, workload, and resource allocation.
• Support recruitment, onboarding, and team capability development.
2. Delivery & Execution
• Translate business and product priorities into development plans, schedules, and deliverables.
• Take ownership of delivery outcomes, timelines, risks, and dependencies.
• Monitor progress, resolve delivery issues, and take corrective action when necessary.
• Coordinate with the Architect and relevant stakeholders to ensure effective execution.
3. Engineering Productivity & Continuous Improvement
• Identify and drive improvements for long-term engineering risks, including security, dependency lifecycle, technical debt, and maintainability.
• Improve development processes, code quality, CI/CD, test automation, and release practices.
• Identify opportunities to improve productivity through automation, AI-assisted development, and modern engineering tools.
• Drive the implementation and adoption of engineering improvements.
4. Technical Coordination
• Work with the Architect to translate technical direction into effective implementation plans.
• Assess technical risks and trade-offs and facilitate technical discussions with engineers.
• Coordinate major application incidents and release issues, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.
Product Scope
• The team is primarily responsible for the HI GIO CLOUD Portal, including:
• IAM, SSO, and role management
• VPC Portal is integrated with VMware Cloud Director and OpenStack
• Monitoring and audit logging
• Billing and back-office integration

Job description
AI in production
- Design, build and operate LLM-powered features end to end: agents with tool or function calling, RAG over internal data and documents, and structured outputs. Integrate them into Go microservices over gRPC/REST.
- Build evaluation into every AI feature: offline eval sets, regression tests, LLM-as-judge where it fits. Monitorquality, latency and cost in production.
- Own AI safety and data governance: scope data access by user permissions, expose only allowlisted fields to models, defend against prompt injection, and handle sensitive data correctly.
- Build data and algorithm pipelines on event streams (Kafka/CDC) and relational data. Backtest recommendations against historical data before go-live.
Backend engineering
- Build and maintain high-throughput, mission-critical Go services in a microservice, event-driven architecture.
- Tune performance across services, databases and caches. Troubleshoot production incidents and drive refactoring.
- Write clean, tested, maintainable code. Review code and raise the engineering bar of the team.
Engineering with AI
- Use AI coding agents every day across the development lifecycle: spec, code, test, review, debug.
- Build internal tools, prompts and workflows that make the whole team faster, while keeping quality under control.
Collaboration
- Work with Product Owners, business and operations teams to turn vague problems into measurable AI solutions.
- Explain model results and trade-offs in plain business language.
Your skills and experience
Must have
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent.
• 4+ years of backend development, including at least 3 years building production Go applications.
• Strong distributed-systems fundamentals : microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka or a similar message broker, gRPC/REST, concurrency and parallel programming.
• Solid database skills: PostgreSQL (query design, indexing, performance tuning), at least one NoSQL database, and distributed caching such as Redis.
• Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-based feature to production , not only a prototype. That includes prompt design, tool or function calling, RAG and structured outputs, plus a clear understanding of the limits: hallucination, latency, token cost.
• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent systems, and with vector search (e.g. pgvector) for retrieval.
• A measure-first mindset: you prove an AI or algorithm change with data and evaluation before calling it done.
• Good data skills (SQL, Python) to analyse data, build datasets and run backtests.
• Ability to drive technical solutions independently and troubleshoot complex issues with minimal supervision.
• Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and good judgement on when to trust their output.
• Good cross-team communication skills.
Nice to have
• Classic ML or optimisation (forecasting, recommendation, operations research).
• Big-data and OLAP technologies (e.g. BigQuery, ClickHouse).
• Docker, Kubernetes and cloud platforms (GCP , AWS).
• Frontend work with React/TypeScript when needed.

At OL Vietnam , we have worked alongside our parent company, Orange Logic LLC, to support some of the world’s largest enterprises with their digital asset management needs. Orange Logic provides a premier Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform that streamlines workflows, enhances collaboration, and ensures compliance across complex digital ecosystems, empowering any team working with digital content the ability to efficiently create, manage, and distribute their content at scale.
WHAT DIFFERENTIATES ORANGE LOGIC
• We are trusted by global leaders to work with over 100 customers, including many of the world's most recognized brands.
• Our business is strong and resilient, even in the face of economic challenges. During the Covid economic downturn, we did not implement layoffs or reduce compensation. Instead, we continued to grow, consistently expanding our team and adding dozens of talented members to our R&D department each year.
• You’ll work with top engineers and team members who are passionate about building flexible, scalable, and streamlined systems that will define the future of business management.
Job Summary: We are seeking a seasoned Software Architect to establish the architectural vision and technical stewardship for OL Vietnam. In this role, you won't just design systems; you will empower our engineering teams by creating clear architectural principles, patterns, and "paved roads" that enable them to build scalable, secure, and maintainable software with velocity. You will lead by influence—facilitating critical design decisions, mentoring engineers, and translating business strategy into a tangible technical roadmap that elevates our entire platform and application landscape.
Essential Functions:
• Architecture Strategy & Governance: Define and evolve the target architecture, principles, tech radar, and roadmaps; steward ADRs; facilitate architecture/design reviews; ensure decisions and trade‑offs are documented and communicated.
• Application Architecture: Lead or facilitate system design for major initiatives; clarify domain boundaries and modularization; guide performance and reliability patterns (caching, concurrency/async, idempotency, retries/timeouts, graceful degradation).
• Platform Architecture & Developer Experience: Establish standards for build/packaging, runtime environments, configuration and secrets, and environment promotion (dev/stage/prod); contribute paved paths (templates, reference repos) for CI/CD, release strategies (e.g., canary/blue‑green when useful), and fast rollbacks.
• Hands-on Leadership & Execution: Lead by example by contributing directly to complex technical challenges, reference implementations, and critical proof-of-concepts. Prove your architectural standards are effective and pragmatic through hands-on implementation.
• Containerization & Orchestration: Validate containerization and orchestration approaches during architectural reviews; align implementations with golden paths.
• Data & Flow: Align integration and data‑flow patterns; recommend persistence choices (relational/NoSQL/search/cache) appropriate to use cases; ensure backup/restore considerations are in place.
• Delivery & Enablement: Create reference implementations and migration plans; mentor engineers and tech leads; raise documentation quality (C4, sequence diagrams, RFCs/ADRs, onboarding guides).
• Stakeholder Leadership: Translate business goals into architecture roadmaps with measurable outcomes; collaborate with product, platform/infra, and security teams.
• Security & Quality Fundamentals: Champion security by design (authn/z, least privilege, encryption) and the adoption of baseline quality gates within the SDLC by partnering closely with platform and security teams.

Key Qualifications:
• 8+ years in software engineering, including 3–5 years as an architect or senior technical lead for distributed systems.
• Depth in application architecture : domain modeling and modularization, API design, event‑driven and integration patterns, performance and reliability trade‑offs; hands‑on design/code reviews.
• Breadth in platform architecture : establishing build/run standards, environment promotion, configuration and secrets management, and developer experience/golden paths.
• Practical experience with cloud platforms and Infrastructure as Code tooling.

• Modern CI/CD practices and the ability to create reusable pipelines/templates and quality gates.

Position Summary / Primary Purpose of the Position (In Brief - why does this position exist?):
The Database Engineer is responsible for the secure and effective operation of all databases of all BUs, related applications, and software that is used within a wide range of CRV. Key Duties & Responsibilities (but not limited to)
• Optimize databases to improve performance
• Develop, manage, and test database back-up and recovery plans

• Troubleshoot and provide root cause analysis of major incidents and problems

• Prepare database deployment scripts and assist with production deployment

activities when required.

stakeholders, and post-incident review.
• Monitor, control, and support service delivery; ensuring systems, methodologies, and procedures are in place and followed.
• Be accountable for the quality of Service and performance; ensuring future demand from growth and projects is understood and factored into capacity plans for all associated
systems.
• Drive internal and third-party service review meetings covering performance, service improvements, quality, and processes.
• Report to Infrastructure Supervisor to provide regular updates on the status and progress of the database projects and initiatives.

Job description
Network Security thuộc đội ngũ Incident Response vận hành 24/7, chịu trách nhiệm giám sát, vận hành, xử lý sự cố và đảm bảo an toàn cho lớp hạ tầng mạng và an ninh thông tin của hệ thống Data Center và Hybrid Cloud.
Job Purpose: Vai trò tập trung vào việc đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng, ổn định và an toàn 24/7 cho hạ tầng kết nối, ứng dụng và dữ liệu quan trọng của tổ chức; đồng thời tham gia xử lý các sự cố mạng, bảo mật theo SLA và quy trình vận hành. Phạm vi công việc bao gồm:
• Thiết kế, triển khai và duy trì hệ thống bảo mật mạng đa tầng.
• Quản trị, vận hành hạ tầng Data Center và Hybrid Cloud.
• Đảm bảo an toàn kết nối và ứng dụng.
• Thực hiện các tiêu chuẩn bảo mật đối với tổ chức trung gian thanh toán.
• Giám sát, tiếp nhận, xử lý và phối hợp khắc phục các sự cố mạng, bảo mật theo mô hình vận hành 24/7.
Responsibilities
1. Network & Infrastructure Security
• Quản trị và tối ưu hóa chính sách trên các thiết bị tường lửa thế hệ mới (NGFW - Palo Alto/Fortinet/Checkpoint) và hệ thống Cloudflare (WAF, DDoS Protection).
• Quản trị, vận hành và đảm bảo an toàn cho hạ tầng mạng tại Data Center và Hybrid Cloud.
• Thiết kế và đảm bảo an ninh cho các kết nối giữa Data Center và Cloud (VPN S2S, Interconnect/Direct Connect).
• Rà soát định kỳ network rules, phân tích log, thực hiện troubleshooting và các biện pháp hardening cho thiết bị mạng.
2. Application & Data Security
• Vận hành chuyên sâu các thiết bị F5 (LTM cho cân bằng tải, ASM/AWAF cho bảo mật ứng dụng web).
• Quản trị hệ thống Database Firewall để giám sát/ngăn chặn các truy vấn độc hại.
• Quản trị hệ thống CyberArk (PAM) nhằm kiểm soát và bảo vệ các tài khoản đặc quyền.
3. Connectivity & Payment Network
• Quản trị và đảm bảo an toàn kết nối kênh truyền với các tổ chức thành viên tham gia mạng lưới chuyển mạch tài chính và trung gian thanh toán.
• Đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng, ổn định và an toàn của các kết nối phục vụ hoạt động nghiệp vụ.
4. 24/7 Incident Response & Operations
• Tham gia giám sát, vận hành hệ thống mạng và an ninh thông tin theo mô hình trực ca 24/7 nhằm đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng, ổn định và an toàn của dịch vụ.
• Tiếp nhận, xử lý, phối hợp khắc phục và thực hiện escalation đối với các sự cố mạng, bảo mật phát sinh trong ca trực theo SLA và quy trình vận hành.
• Tham gia xử lý các sự cố nghiêm trọng ngoài giờ làm việc khi cần thiết.
• Thực hiện bàn giao ca, cập nhật nhật ký vận hành và phối hợp với các đơn vị liên quan để đảm bảo hoạt động liên tục của hệ thống 24/7.
5. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Viết và cập nhật tài liệu thiết kế, triển khai và vận hành hệ thống.
• Tham gia đào tạo, hướng dẫn và chuyển giao kiến thức cho L1.
• Phối hợp với các đơn vị liên quan trong quá trình xử lý sự cố, triển khai thay đổi và cải thiện chất lượng vận hành

The Head of Information Security is responsible for leading the overall information security agenda across VPBanks Securities, ensuring that the company’s technology platforms, trading
systems, customer data, digital channels, cloud environments, business operations, and third- party ecosystems are protected against evolving cyber and information security risks.
This role plays a strategic and enterprise-wide leadership role in supporting VPBanks Securities’ ambition to become a leading securities and digital investment platform in Vietnam. The position is accountable for building a mature, resilient, scalable, and business-enabling information security capability that supports digital trading growth, cloud adoption, data-driven services, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience.
Key Responsibilities
Information Security Strategy and Governance
• Develop and execute the enterprise information security strategy aligned with VPBanks Securities’ business strategy, digital transformation roadmap, technology modernization,
and risk appetite.
• Establish and maintain information security governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements across the company.
• Define the information security target operating model, including people, process, technology, governance, metrics, and accountability.

Enterprise Security Assurance
• Lead the overall security assurance program for trading platforms, core securities systems, customer portals, mobile applications, APIs, infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, and critical business services.

major transformation programs.

operations.

Cloud and Digital Security

applications, and cloud infrastructure.

and compliance.

Security Operations and Incident Response
• Oversee security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, cyber crisis management, and security operations capabilities.

security technologies.

major security incidents.

• Ensure compliance with applicable requirements from the State Securities Commission of Vietnam, Vietnam Exchange, HOSE, HNX, VSDC, cybersecurity and data protection laws, and other relevant financial market regulations.

the company.

sharing, and sensitive data handling.

parties.

• Build a high-performance security culture with clear ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Design and deliver security awareness programs for employees, management, technology teams, and business units.

YOUR NEW ROLE CODE LEAP
CODE LEAP is seeking ​an experienced Senior Full-stack Engineer (.NET + Typescript) who will ​help strengthen our backend development. The ideal engineer will bring their experiences, best practices, and a collaborative attitude to ​help drive agile culture initiatives. To be successful, one ​should effectively communicate with our development and operations team to orchestrate the creation or improvement of solutions that can scale. ​Our team aims for the sustainability!
YOUR EXCITING TASKS
• You design and build the services behind our reconciliation engine – ingesting and normalising settlement files from banks and payment providers and matching them against our transaction data
• You own correctness: idempotent processing, traceable matches, and safe reprocessing of historical data
• You integrate new banks and payment providers and keep those integrations maintainable
• You build and maintain back-end services in Node.js and TypeScript with Effect, modelling failures as typed errors and composing services through layers, so that integrations and jobs stay testable and safe to retry
• You build the interface Finance works in all day – reviewing unmatched transactions, investigating discrepancies and resolving them – and make a data-heavy domain usable: large tables, search and filtering at high volume, drill-downs from summary to single transaction
• You build the review and resolution workflows – assigning cases, manual matches, comments and audit trails – and make uploads, imports and long-running jobs predictable, with clear progress and error reporting
• You own features end to end, from API contract to screen, and shape requirements with Product and Finance into software they can work with
• You make the architectural decisions for a greenfield system – backend modules and data model, frontend structure, state management and data fetching – and keep it observable, performant, accessible and well tested
• You review code and help set the engineering standard for a new team
Your skills and experience

• Several years of professional experience building production software across the full stack. You may be stronger on one side, but you are productive on both.

• Performance optimization and accessibility in data-heavy web applications

• Git and collaborative workflows: pull requests and code reviews
• Clear written and spoken English for working with colleagues in Germany
